tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta chen po'i smad cha bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta chen po'i smad cha bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta chen po'i smad cha bzhugs so/ /

de ltar smon pa tshad med pa bzhis sems rgyud legs par sbyangs rjes/ brgyad pa rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho'i snying por gyur pa 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gtso bor bshad pa'i le'u la spyi don gsum ste/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgom par bstan pa/ sems bskyed tshul dngos rgyas par bshad pa/ skabs kyi dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /spyi don dang po chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems gnyis bsgom par bstan pa ni/ da ni byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa nyid brjod par bya ste/ bshad ma thag pa'i tshul/ de ltar tshad med legs par goms pa yis/ /chos kun rtsa ba byang chub sems gnyis bsgom/ / zhes smos te/ de'ang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ lam thams cad kyi snying po/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dren pa/ myur du bla na med pa'i khang bzangs su bgrod pa'i bzhon pa ni lhag pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi sems yin pas/ 'dir de bskyed pa la bslab par bya ste/ byams pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ byams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chos gcig dang ldan na/ ngan song thams cad spong zhing sdig pa'i grogs po'i lag tu mi 'gro la/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ste/ chos gcig po de gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa byang chub kyi sems yin te/ byams pa/ chos de dang ldan na/ ngan song thams cad spong zhing sdig pa'i grogs po'i lag tu mi 'gro la/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya'o zhes pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi mdo las/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/ lhag pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o zhes so/ / spyi don gnyis pa sems bskyed nyid rgyas par bshad pa la bcu ste/

dang po phan yon bshad pa la'ang drug las/ srid nas zhi bar 'dren pa'i phan yon ni/ de dag gi yon tan ji lta bu zhe na/ de yang nyon mongs srid mtsho mthar 'byin zhing*/ /'jigs dang mya ngan sdig kun sel byed de/ / las dang sdug bsngal 'du byed rnam par 'joms/ /srid nas zhi bar 'gro ba 'dren byed yin/ /zhes smos te/ 'di ltar srid pa'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba ni/ sdong po bkod pa las/ kye rigs kyi bu/ byang chub kyi sems ni srid pa'i chu bo las sgrol ba'i gru bo che lta bu'o zhes so/ /'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las sgrol ba'i skyel ma dpa' bo lta bu ste/ byams pa'i rnam par thar pa las/ rigs kyi bu/ 'di lte ste/ dpa' bo la brten pa ni dgra thams cad kyis mi 'jigs so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du sems bskyed pa dpa' bo brten pa yang spyod pa ngan pa'i dgra thams cad kyis mi 'jigs so zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang*/ /dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar/ /gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba/ /de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten/ /zhes so/ /mya ngan dang sdig pa mtha' dag kyang sel bar/ de nyid las/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag gzhom 'dod cing*/ / sems can mi bde bsal bar 'dod pa dang*/ /bde mang brgya phrag spyad par 'dod pas kyang*/ /byang chub sems nyid rtag tu btang mi bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'phags pa theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi mdo las/ mi gang la la byang chub rdul dang bral ba bla med zhing 'jug pa/ /de ni ngan song ngan 'gro'i lam dang mi khom brgyad po thams cad gcog /de ni lha dang mi yi lam rnams rab tu dbye zhing rnam par sbyangs/ /long bar mi 'gyur 'on par ma yin dbang po thams cad tshang bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /las dang nyon mongs pa'i bud shing bsreg pas me dang 'dra ba nyid kyang*/

snga ma las/ des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed/ / ces pa dang*/ byams pa'i rnam thar las/ nyes pa thams cad bsreg pas bskal pa 'tshig pa'i me lta bu'o zhes so/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas thob par byed pas srid pa nas 'dren pa yin te/ /spyod 'jug las/ 'di ni tshad med skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bde mchog bde blag nyid du thob par byed/ / ces so/ / 'jig rten gyi mchod sdong du 'gro ba'i phan yon ni/ gzhan yang sems bskyed pa de yod pa'i mi/ /gang la sems dpa' mngon gyur med na yang*/ /snying rje'i dge rgyun gong nas gong 'phel zhing*/ /mnyam gzhag na yang thabs shes zung du 'brel/ / lus ngag rtsom pa thams cad don yod cing*/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi mchod sdong 'gyur/ /'di ltar sems bskyed pa de thob la ma nyams par yod pas sems mi rtog par mnyam par bzhag pa na yang*/ de'i shes rab de dang zung du 'brel ba dang*/ gnyid du song ba dang*/ brgyal ba dang*/ dran pa'i 'du shes med par snyoms par 'jug pa dang*/ 'du shes dang tshor ba dang 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang*/ rtag tu 'du shes med pa ste gnas skabs lngar sems mngon gyur pa med par/ sum cu pa las/ yid kyi rnam shes 'byung ba ni/ /sems med gnyid dang brgyal ba dang*/ /snyoms par 'jug pa rnam gnyis dang*/ /rtag tu 'du shes med pa 'o/ /zhes pa ltar gyur pa na'ang sems bskyed sngar thob la ma nyams par yod na bsod nams rgyun mi 'chad par yod pa nyid/ spyod 'jug las/ gang nas bzung ste sems can khams/ / mtha' yas rab tu grol ba'i phyir/ /mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su/ /sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa/ /de nas bzung ste gnyid log gam/ /bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun mi 'chad par du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung*/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang rtsom pa thams cad don yod par/

sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gang dang ldan pa de'i lus dang ngag dang sems kyi rtsom pa thams cad don yod pa ste/ rtag tu dge ba 'ba' zhig tu ro gcig par 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /de'ang gang ci bya ba lung ma bstan dang*/ dge ba ci spyod pa thams cad sems bskyed mngon gyur gyis 'phral du ma zin kyang*/ thob la ma nyams pa'i sems bskyed kyis zin pas thar pa cha mthun gyi dge bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /'jig rten gyi mchod sdong du 'gyur ba yang*/ sdong po bkod pa las/ sems bskyed pa de dang ldan pa ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi mchod sdong chen po'o zhes so/ / dge ba gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i phan yon ni/ 'di ltar bsod nams cha mthun gyi/ dge gzhan 'bras bu dman te zad pa ltar/ /rin chen sems zin dge ba mi zad 'phel/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho dngas pa'i chu 'bab dang*/ /sa gzhi bzang por lo thog phun tshogs bzhin/ /'di ltar rgya mtshor bab pa'i chu thigs pa gcig kyang bskal pa'i bar du mi zad cing 'phel ba dang*/ sa gzhi bzang por til nyag ma gcig btab kyang rgya cher 'phel ba ltar/ sems bskyed pas zin pa'i dge ba yang de dang 'dra ste/ byams pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ byams pa/ 'di lta ste dper na/ rgya mtsho chen por chu gang ji snyed cig bab pa de dag bskal pa'i bar du zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /byams pa/ de bzhin du byang chub tu sems bskyed pas zin pa'i dge ba yang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas kyi bar du zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /byams pa/ yang 'di lta ste dper na/ 'byung khungs bzang bar gang ci yang rung ba'i sa bon thams cad rgyas shing 'phel ba de bzhin du byang chub kyi sems kyis zin pa'i dge ba yang rgya cher 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes so/ / gzhan yang bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba chu shing ltar lan gcig 'bras bu phyung nas zad pa lta bu ma yin par/

gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde 'bras dpag tu med pa byung yang mi zad cing 'phel ba 'bras ldan chen po'i ljon shing lta bu ste/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ /'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*/ /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ za ma tog bkod pa las/ 'jam dpal/ 'di lta ste/ shing ljon pa sna tshogs pa ni khams bzhis bzung nas rnam par 'phel lo/ / 'jam dpal/ de bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba yang byang chub kyi sems kyis gzung zhing rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du bsngos na rnam par 'phel lo zhes so/ / chos thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i phan yon ni/ gzhan yang legs pa'i chos ma lus pa/ kun gyi rtsa ba sa bon snying rje'i bdag /srid pa na yang bde ba'i 'bras mang zhing*/ /zhi ba'i rang bzhin byang chub mchog gi rgyu/ /rin chen sems legs bskyed la 'bad par mdzod/ /ji skad du/ tshangs pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ tshangs pa/ 'di la lhag pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi sems gang yin pa de ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pas sa bon lta bu'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sa bon las ni myu gu dang*/ lo ma dang*/ me tog dang 'bras bu 'byung ba de bzhin du/ lhag pa'i bsam pa las ni lha dang mi'i nang du bde ba du ma myong zhing*/ slar yang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du byed do zhes pa dang*/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ rgyal po chen po/ khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pas lan du mar lha'i nang du skyais te bde ba myong*/ lan du mar mi'i nang du skyes te bde ba myong*/ lha dang mir bcas pa thams cad du yang dbang po byed par gyur kyang*/ da dung du'ang rgyal po khyod kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi dge ba'i rtsa bas bri ba'am gang bar mi mngon no zhes so/

/ sdug bsngal gyi nad gso zhing ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed pa'i phan yon ni/ gzhan yang phan yon tshad med de/ sems bskyed pa/ de ni dpal rgyas yid bzhin bum pa bzang*/ / 'gro ba'i nad gso bde 'byung sman gyi mchog /ye shes nyi ma gdung sel zla ba ste/ /mkha' bzhin dri med yon tan rgyu skar tshogs/ /rtag tu phan bde byed pa'i rang bzhin la/ zhes pa ni/ sdong po bkod pa las/ byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi chos dkar po rnam par 'phel bar byed pas zhing lta bu'o/ /nyes pa thams cad bsreg pas bskal pa'i me lta bu'o/ /mi dge ba thams cad zad par byed pas sa'i 'og lta bu'o/ /don thams cad 'grub pas yid kyi nor bu'i rgyal po lta bu'o/ /'khor ba'i chu bo la rgyu ba 'don pas lcags kyu lta bu'o/ /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten na mchod sdong lta bu'o/ /bsam pa thams cad 'grub pas bum pa bzang po lta bu'o zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba yi/ /mi zad gter yang 'di yin no/ / 'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i/ /sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /srid lam 'khyams shing dub pa yi/ /'gro ba'i ngal gso'i ljon shing yin/ /'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las/ /sgrol bar byed pa'i spyi stegs yin/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdungs sel ba'i/ /sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin/ /'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag /dpyis 'byin nyi ma chen po yin/ /dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las/ /mar gyi nying khu phyung ba yin/ /'gro ba'i 'gron po srid pa'i lam rgyu zhing*/ /bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la/ /'di ni bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gnas te/ /sems can 'gron chen tshim par byed pa yin/ /zhes so/ / yon tan rgya che ba'i phan yon ni/

de lta bu'i yon tan tshad med cing blos/ bsam yas bsod nams sprin tshogs dpag tu med/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan shin tu rmad byung dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings ltar dpag yas rgya che 'o/ /'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos dpag tu med pa 'dzin pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi mdo las/ shā ri'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos gcig dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di dag dang gzhan yang dpag tu med pa dag yongs su 'dzin to/ /chos gcig po de gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa byang chub kyi sems te/ shā ri'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos gcig po de dang ldan na sangs rgyas kyi chos 'di dag dang gzhan yang dpag tu med pa dag yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /de bzhin du chos kyi rnam pa du ma dag kyang snang zhing sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur te/ chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste/ gang bsam pa ma mchis pa de la sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ring ba lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das/ bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa la ni/ gal te sangs rgyas mi bzhugs na'ang nam mkha'i dkyil dang*/ rtsig pa dang*/ shing ljon pa rnams las kyang chos kyi sgra 'byung ngo*/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa dag pa la ni rang gi yid kyis dpyod pa nyid las gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa thams cad 'byung ngo*/ /de bas na byang chub sems dpas bsam pa phun sum tshogs par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das/ 'di lta ste dper na/ gang la rkang pa mchis pa de la 'gro ba mchis so/ /de bzhin du gang la bsam pa mchis pa de la sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams mchis so/ / bcom ldan 'das/ 'di lta ste dper na/ yan lag gi dang po mgo mchis pa de la 'tsho ba mchis so/ /de bzhin du lhag pa'i bsam pa gang la yod pa de la sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mchis so zhes so/

/ gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'i mchog tu 'gyur te/ khyim bdag dpal sbyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas zhing rnams mi gang gis/ /rin chen bdun gyis yongs bkang nas/ /'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas/ /gang gis thal mo sbyar byas te/ /byang chub tu ni sems btud nas/ /mchod pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /de la mtha' ni ma mchis so/ / zhes pa dang*/ 'phags pa zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ bye ba khrag khrig gtams pa'i zhing dag na/ /mchod pa rnam mang dpag med ji snyed pa/ /skyes mchog rnams la de yis rtag mchod pas/ /byams pa'i sems kyi grangs dang char mi phod/ /ces pa dang*/ sgo mtha' yas pa rnam par sbyong ba'i mdo las/ tshangs pa/ gsum po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba bla na med pa'o/ / bsod nams tshad med pa'o/ /gsum gang zhe na/ gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dang*/ gang ji ltar thos pa rnams de bzhin du bsgrub pa ste/ tshangs pa/ gsum po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa dang*/ rim gro bya ba bla na med pa'o/ /tshangs pa/ gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshe'i tshad bskal par bzhugs nas/ mchod pa'i dngos po 'di dag gi rnam par smin pa bstan yang bskal pa zad par 'gyur gyi/ bsod nams kyi phung po de'i phan yon zad par mi 'gyur ro zhes so/ / gzhan yang ngan song las thar nas zhi ba dam pa 'thob pa la sogs pa tshad med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ phyag bya ba'i 'os su 'gyur te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing*/ /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ dman pa mchog tu gyur ba yang*/ de nyid las/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bur/

/mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan zung*/ / zhes so/ /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*/ /de la gal te gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ sdong po bkod pa las/ mdor na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la legs pa yod pa ji lta bar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i legs pa dang yon tan yang de tsam ste/ nam mkha'i khams dang chos kyi dbyings ltar rgya che'o zhes so/ /de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyis phan par dgongs nas bstan te/ spyod 'jug las/ bskal pa du mar rab dgongs mdzad pa yi/ /thub dbang rnams kyis de nyid phan par gzigs/ /zhes so/ / de dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la bsngags pa yang*/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' de ni zhing chen po ste/ la la zhig gis khro bar byas na yang bsod nams ma yin pa tshad med pa dang de'i 'bras bus ngan song skyed par byed de/ de nyid las/ gang zhig de 'dra'i rgyal sras sbyin bdag la/ /gal te ngan sems skyed par byed na de/ /ngan sems bskyed pa'i grangs bzhin bskal par ni/ / dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs/ / zhes dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa cho 'phrul gyi mdor/ 'jam dpal/ byang chub sems dpa' la khong khro dang brnyas pa'i sems ji snyed pa de tsam gyis bskal par dmyal bar gnas pas go cha bgo bar bya'o zhes so/ /'on te dad pas dge ba byed na lhag par yang bsod nams 'phel bar/ snga ma las/ 'on te gang zhig yid rab dang byed na/ /de yi 'bras bu de bas lhag par 'phel/ /zhes so/ /ji ltar 'phel na/ nges pa dang ma nges pa la 'jug pa phyag rgya'i mdo las/ 'jam dpal/ yongs su rtag par gzung ste dper bya na/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can thams cad kyi mig phyung bar gyur pa las/

gang la la zhig gis de dag gi mig bskyed pa'am/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can thams cad btson ra mun pa mun nag can du btsud pa bton te/ 'khor los sgyur ba'am tshangs pa'i bde ba la bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la dad pa'i sems kyis blta zhing bsngags pa brjod na/ /'di de bas bsod nams ches grangs med pa bskyed do zhes so/ /gzhan yang nyon mongs pa'i sems kyis blta na'ang ngan song du mi 'gro zhing mtho ris su skye na dad pas blta ba ni lta ci smos te/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' byed ces bya ba gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug pa zhig mnyan yod du bsod snyoms spyod pa na/ tshong dpon gyi bu mo dpal yon can gyi mchog ces bya bas mthong ste/ bu mo de dag 'dod chags kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gdung bzhin du tshe'i dus byas te sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes so/ /der lha'i bu des sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran te/ e ma byang chub sems dpa' la 'dod chags kyi sems kyis bltas pas kyang rnam par smin pa 'di lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur na/ dad pas mchod cing bltas na lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam nas/ lha'i 'khor lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu 'ongs te me tog la sogs pas mchod par byas so zhes so/ /gzhan yang de la ma dad pas ngan song du song yang mthar de'i thugs rjes skyob pas 'khor ba'i pha rol du sgrol zhing*/ dad pas 'brel na'ang don yod pas myur du byang chub 'thob ste/ dkon brtsegs las/ gang la la zhig gis byang chub sems dpa' la sdig pa'i las byas pa dag kyang*/ las des ngan song du song ba las/ slar yang byang chub sems dpa' des brtson pa chen pos thar bar byas te/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'jog go zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/

bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gis/ khro ba'am dad pa'i sems byung na/ /de nyid rtag tu de dag gi /don kun grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa dang*/ gang la gnod pa byas kyang bder 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs ku mchi/ /zhes so/ /

gnyis pa ngo bo bshad pa la'ang bdun las/ smon 'jug gnyis spyir bstan pa ni/ da ni sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo bshad par bya ste/ 'di ltar byang chub mchog tu/ sems bskyed pa ni tshad med 'gro ba'i phyir/ /yang dag sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa ste/ / smon dang 'jug pa'i rang bzhin gnyis yin no/ /de yang bsam pas smon dang sbyor bas khyab/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba nyid bzhin no/ /de la sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces so/ /de yang sems ni don gyi ngo bo rigs pa yin la/ sems byung de'i khyad par la dpyod pas na/ 'dir ngo bo bskyed pas khyad par zhar la bskyed par 'gyur te/ 'dun pa sems bskyed la sogs pa zhar la thob pa bzhin no/ /de la ngo bo gnyis las/ smon pa sems bskyed ni byang chub thob par 'dun pa yin la/ 'jug pa ni de'i chos la sbyor ba ste/ bsam pas smon pa dang sbyor bas khyab pa nyid 'gro bar 'dod pa dang 'gro bzhin pa lta bur/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ / 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /de la 'dir dbye tshul du ma shes par bya ste/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sems bskyed pa gnyis su yang yod de/ myang 'das las/ kun rdzob don dam dbye ba yis/ /byang chub sems de rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes so/ /de'ang so so'i skye bo dang 'phags pa'i sems bskyed pa gnyis sam/ phyi rol sems can la dmigs pa dang*/ nang sems nyid la dmigs pa gnyis kyis kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa chen po'i mdo las/

byang chub sems dpa' 'od srungs kyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das/ sems ji ltar bskyed par bgyi/ bka' stsal pa/ chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar mtshan nyid med cing ye nas 'od gsal ba rnam par dag pa de la ni byang chub ces bya'o/ /de dang mthun pa'i sems sngon ma skyes pa'i sems rin po che skyes pa la ni byang chub tu sems bskyed pa zhes bya'o zhes so/ /tshul khrims gsum mam bslab pa gsum la ltos nas sems bskyed pa gsum du'ang yod de/ yum bar ma las/ gang kha na ma tho ba sdom pa'i sems dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i sems dang*/ sems can smin par byed pa'i sems te/ sems bskyed pa 'di gsum la nan tan du bya'o zhes so/ /tshogs sbyor na mos pas spyod pa dang*/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar lhag bsam dag pa dang*/ dag pa sa gsum na rnam par smin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed pa ste bzhir yang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ sems bskyed de ni sa rnams la/ /mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang*/ /rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ / zhes so/ /tshogs dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ sgom pa dang*/ mi slob pa'i lam lnga'i sems bskyed pa lngar yang yod de/ nyi khri las/ las dang po pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ yongs su sbyang ba byas pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ chos mthong ba'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ rnam par grol ba'i sems bskyed pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sems bskyed pa ste/ rab 'byor/ 'di la ma zhugs pa gzhug par bya'o/ /zhugs pa yongs su sbyang bar bya'o/ /lha'i mig bskyed par bya'o/ /'phags pa'i lam bden bsgom par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyan sgrib pa med pa thob par bya'o zhes so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa drug la ltos nas drug tu yang yod de/ de nyid las/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa tshad med pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong du ma gyur pa ste zhes so/

/pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la ltos nas bcur yang yod de/ dge ba'i lhas/ de ltar nang du yang dag 'jog pa'i bsam gtan gyis byang chub kyi sems rnam pa bcu bsgoms nas zhes so/ /sa mtshams kyis dbye na nyi shu rtsa gnyis dpes bstan pa nyid/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pa ltar/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ /gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho/ /rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang*/ /yid bzhin nor bu nyi ma glu/ /rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che/ /bzhon pa bkod ma'i cha dang ni/ /sgra brnyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis/ / rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes so/ /dpe de dag gi don ni rim pa ltar/ de'i bgrel pa las/ 'dun pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa dang*/ smon lam dang*/ stobs dang*/ ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ bsod nams dang ye shes dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos dang*/ snying rje dang lhag mthong dang*/ gzungs dang spobs pa dang*/ chos kyi dga' ston dang*/ bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang*/ chos kyi sku dang ldan pa ni zhes so/ /sa mtshams ni/ 'dun pa sa lta bu dang*/ bsam pa gser lta bu dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa zla ba tshes pa lta bu gsum ni rim pa ltar tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum gyi sems bskyed la de skad ces btags so/ /sbyor ba me lta bu ni sbyor lam bzhi'i sems bskyed do/ /sbyin pa gter lta bu dang*/ tshul khrims rin po che'i 'byung gnas lta bu dang*/ bzod pa mtsho lta bu dang*/ brtson 'grus rdo rje lta bu dang*/ bsam gtan ri lta bu dang*/ shes rab sman lta bu dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa bshes gnyen lta bu dang*/ smon lam yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu dang*/ stobs nyi ma lta bu dang*/

ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glu dbyangs snyan pa lta bu ni sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar la rim pa bzhin no/ /mngon shes rgyal po lta bu dang*/ tshogs gnyis mdzod khang lta bu dang*/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos lam po che lta bu dang*/ snying rje lhag mthong gnyis bzhon pa bzang po lta bu dang*/ gzungs spobs gnyis bkod ma'i chu mig lta bu lnga ni sa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa gsum ka la khyab par yod do/ /chos kyi dga' ston sgra brnyan lta bu dang*/ bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam chu bo lta bu dang*/ chos kyi sku dang mtshungs par ldan pa sprin lta bu gsum ni sa bcu pa la yod de ye shes dang 'phrin las chen pos sems can gyi don byed pa'i phyir ro/ de skad du'ang 'grel pa don gsal las/ de la dang po gsum ni chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po nyid kyis las dang po pa'i sas bsdus so/ /de'i 'og tu gcig ni sa dang po la 'jug pa'i lam gyis bsdus so/ /de'i 'og tu bcu ni rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa sa bcus bsdus te/ /mthong ba dang sgom pa'i lam gyi spyod yul can yin no/ / de'i 'og tu lnga ni khyad par gyi lam gyis bsdus so/ de'i 'og tu sems bskyed pa gsum ni/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos dang*/ mjug gi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyis sas bsdus te/ de ltar na sems bskyed pa'i rab tu dbye ba ni las dang po pa'i sa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar gyis bsdus pa yin no zhes so/ kha cig skabs 'di'i tha ma gsum kun du 'od kyi sa la sbyor ba'i lung du 'chad pa mi rigs te/ sangs rgyas kyis de la 'jug mi dmigs pa'i phyir te/ zad pa'am mtha' mi dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas kyis zhes pa theg chen gyi dgra bcom zhugs pa'i sa ste bcu pa'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum du bshad cing*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rgyal sras rnams kyi sems bskyed pa/ /sprin dang 'dra bar bstan pa yin/

/zhes pas nyi shu rtsa gnyis po 'di tshogs lam nas sa bcu pa'i bar du gsungs pa yin no/ /'dir sangs rgyas kyi sa na sems bskyed yod dam med ce na/ slob lam pa'i sems bskyed ltar da gzod thob par 'dod pa med de thob zin pa'i phyir dang*/ khas blangs pa'i dus las 'das pa'i phyir cho gas blangs pa'i sems bskyed med pa yin no/ /don dam sems bskyed yod de chos nyid kyis thob pa'i sems bskyed thob la ma nyams pa gong nas gong du yod pa'i phyir te/ dor ba med pa'i stong pa nyid yod pa'i phyir dang*/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen pos don mdzad pa yod de/ yum bar ma las/ ngas sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs shing sems bskyed pa gang dang ldan pas shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ sems can gang dag dmyal ba dang yi dgas dang dud 'gro'i skye gnas su song ba de dag la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir chos bstan te zhes so/ /de ltar nyi shu rtsa gnyis la/ slob dpon dpal ye shes grags pa ni dang po gsum smon pa/ phyi ma bcu dgu 'jug par 'dod de/ 'dun sogs gsum gyi dbye ba yis/ /smon pa'i sems ni rnam pa gsum/ /'jug pa'i sems zhes bya ba ni/ /rnam pa bcu dgu dag tu bzhed/ /ces gsungs kyang*/ de re re'i skabs su smon 'jug gnyis gnyis yod par 'dod dgos te/ smon pa ni byang chub don du gnyer ba'i cha de yin la/ 'jug pa sbyor bas lag len la khyad par byed pa'i cha gnyis po tshang dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /sems bskyed pa'i rten yang*/ sems tsam pa ltar na dang po ma thob pa thob par byed pa la so sor thar pa rigs bdun gang rung gi rten la skye ste/ byang chub lam sgron las/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi/ /rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi/ /skal pa yod kyis gzhan du min/ /zhes so/ /dbu ma pa ltar na sems bskyed len 'dod kyi bsam pa gang yod du skye yi dal 'byor gyi lus kho na mi dgos te/

dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ de'i tshe chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ lto 'phye chen po bgrang ba las 'das pa dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do zhes so/ /lugs 'di gnyis kyang don gyis mi 'gal bar go ste/ 'di ltar sems bskyed dus so sor thar pa'i sdom par ming ma btags kyang*/ don 'dra bar srog mi gcod par dam 'cha' nus pa la sogs pa dgos pas/ de'i cha nas rten 'dra rung du nges te/ don la gnod pa las blo log pa zhig la skye nges so/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa gang rung sdom nus pa zhig med na gang la'ang mi skye ste/ sems bskyed de nyid kyi bslab pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ / mdor na gang len par 'dod pa'i 'gro ba de'i sa pas bsdus pa ni lus kyi rten yin la/ dad sogs bsod nams kyi blo khyad par can ni bsam pa'i rten yin te/ dkon mchog ta la la'i mdo las/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing*/ /byang chub bla na med la'ang dad gyur la/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la dad byed na/ /blo dang ldan pa rnams kyi sems skye'o/ /zhes so/ / gnas pa'i rten yang*/ gang la skyes pa de'i rten la nyams pa'i rgyu ma byung gi bar du gnas so/ /sems bskyed pa'i rgyu ni sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dad pa/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ byang chub sems kyi phan yon thob pa ste gsum las skye bar/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ grogs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ /thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba/ /gzhan gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /ces so/ /de'ang grogs dam pa bsten pa'am dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bskul zhing thos pa byas pa las smon pa sems bskyed pa mi brtan pa'i rgyu dang por 'byung zhing*/ rang gis dge ba goms pa dang*/

rgyu rigs sad pa dang*/ rtsa ba snying rje skyes pa las ni 'jug pa sems bskyed pa brtan pa bskyed pa'i rgyur skyes rjes las 'byung ba ste 'di dag yin par brjod do/ / sems bskyed pa'i ngo bo yang*/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob 'dod dang ma bral ba'i sems smon 'jug gis bsdus pa gang zhig pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi ngo bor gyur pa ste/ sdong po bkod pa las/ byang chub kyi sems de yang gzhan gyi don du chas pa ste/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i rang bzhin pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang ldan pa gang yin pa'o zhes so/ /de'ang byang chub kyi sems gnyis dang*/ tshul khrims gsum dang*/ sdom pa zhes ldog pas phye yang ngo bo gcig ste/ gzhan don du sems pa dang dge ba spyod pas smon 'jug ste/ slob dpon shes rab 'byung gnas kyi thub pa dgongs rgyan du/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis ka yang gzhan gyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa nyid las mi 'da' yang zhes so/ /de'ang rang gi rgyud sdom pas sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ de las gzhan phan byed pas sems can don byed/ tshogs gnyis la sogs pa spel bas dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims zhes bya la/ de thams cad kyis kyang rang gi rgyud kyi mi dge ba cha dang bcas pa sdom pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /dper na rin po che gcig la'ang rims nad sel ba dang*/ dgos 'dod 'byung ba dang*/ mun pa sel ba la sogs pa ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i cha tha dad du yod pa bzhin no/ / so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa ni/ da ni smon 'jug gi ngo bo bshad pa/ smon pa tshad med bzhi yi ngo bo la/ 'jug pa pha rol phyin pa drug tu 'dod/ de yang*/ byams pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ byams pa/ de la gzhan gyi don du smon pa yang byams pa chen po dang*/ snying rje chen po dang*/ dga' ba chen po dang*/ btang snyoms chen po yin la/

yang dag par spyod pa de yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug ste zhes so/ / smon sems kyi phan yon bshad pa ni/ de gnyis so so'i bye brag phan yon gyi sgo nas kyang shes par bya ba las/ re zhig smon pa'i phan yon ni/ 'gro ba/ gang gis phyogs mtha' gtugs pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por bsnyen bkur te/ /rang nyid legs pa tsam zhig don gnyer ba'i/ /bsod nams de yis smon pa'i char mi phod/ /ji skad du/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs las/ gang gis sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rin chen bdun dang gzim cha dang*/ /zhal zas lnga rdzas dpag med kyis/ /nam 'tsho'i bar du mchod pa bas/ /skad cig tsam zhig sems can gyi/ /don du byang chub smon pa mchog /de la tshad ni ma mchis so/ /zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ skyes bu gang zhig byang chub sems/ /skad cig tsam ni sgom byed na/ /de yi bsod nas phung po ni/ /rgyal ba yis kyang bgrang mi spyod/ /ces so/ / mtshungs pa'i dpe bshad pa ni/ de'i 'thad pa 'god pa/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal nyung zad sel ba'i blo/ /skad cig skyes pas ngan song thar 'gyur zhing*/ /lha mi bde ba dpag med myong bar gsungs/ /ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mos karsha pa ṇi bzhi dang*/ brgyad dang*/ bcu drug dang*/ sum rtsa gnyis byin nas ma'i mgo bo la rdog pas bsnun pas/ rgya mtsho'i gling du lha'i bu mo bzhi dang*/ brgyad dang*/ bcu drug dang*/ sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis bsu zhing dge ba'i las zad nas/ lho phyogs kyi lcags kyi khang par tshud de mgo la gsor 'khor ba'i skad cig la 'di snyam du dzambū'i gling na ma'i mgo la rdog pas bsnub pa mang na de dag kyang 'dir 'ong nges kyi/ bdag gi 'dis go chod nas de dag 'dir mi skye bar shog cig snyam pa'i skad cig la gsor 'khor 'phro chad de tshe'i dus byas nas dga' ldan gyi lhar skyes pa dang*/ ston pa 'di dmyal ba'i gnas su gyad bag shi tar skyes dus me'i shing rta 'dren pa las ka ma rū pas shing rta ma 'drongs pa la gshin rje'i wa khros te me'i tho bas bsnun pa la snying rjai skyes te/

gyad bag shin tas shing rta 'dren par brtsams pas/ gshin rjes tho bas bsdigs te/ rang rang gi las la spyod pa la sus ci bya zhes pa'i skad cig la sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes pa la sogs pa tshad med pa'i yon tan gsungs so/ /

'jug pa'i phan yon bshad pa ni/ smon pa'i sems la phan yon chen po 'thob pa/ de bas 'jug pa'i phan yon mtha' yas te/ /dngos su sbyor bas yang dag khyab ba'i phyir/ /skad cig sbyor bas khyab pa'i sems mchog gis/ /bskal pa mang po'i tshogs gnyis bzlums par bshad/ /'di ltar lhag pa'i bsam pas kun nas bslangs te sbyor ba'i skad cig la phan yon tshad med cing smon pa tsam la'ang phan yon tshad med pa'i phyir te/ 'dir bu mo zla mchog gi mdo las/ gzhan la phan pa'i sems tsam la'ang*/ /phan yon shin tu tshad med na/ /phan par mdzad rnams smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ phan par bsams pa tsam gyis kyang*/ /sangs rgyas mchod las khyad 'phags na/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /bde don brtson pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes so/ /de'i 'thad pa yang*/ mi nag mdung thung can bsad pas tshogs bskal pa bzhi khri bzlums pa dang*/ bram ze'i khye'u skar ma la dga' bas lo nyi khrir nags su tshangs par spyad de grong khyer du bsod snyoms la byon pa tshong dpon gyi bu mos mthong nas/ khyim thab tu gsol bar khas ma blangs pas 'chi bar sems pa na/ srog las bskyab pa'i phyir tshangs spyod btang bas tshogs bskal pa nyi khri zlums pa la sogs pa gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las gsungs pa bzhin no/ /de yang smon pa la 'bras bu rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i bsod nams med la/ 'jug pa la bsod nams rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i khyad zhugs pa'ang yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub smon pa'i sems las ni/ /'khor tshe 'bras bu che 'byung yang*/ /ji ltar 'jug pa'i sems bzhin du/ /bsod nams rgyud chags 'byung ba min/ / zhes so/ / blo'i stobs kyis tshogs bzlums tshul bshad pa ni/ da ni tshogs skad cig re res mang po bzlums par bshad pa'i zhar la blo dman pa dag gis log rtog dgag pa ni/ rgyu mtshan/ de phyir grangs med gsum sogs gsungs pa kun/

/myur du rdzogs dang ring du rdzogs pa dang*/ /tshe gcig grol ba blo yi stobs la rag / de yang thabs dang brtson 'grus shes rab mchog /gsum gyis sgrub gang bla med stobs che 'o/ /'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' dbang po shin tu rtul po rnams ni grangs med pa sum cu rtsa gsum ste/ tshogs dang sbyor ba'i lam gnyis su gsum/ sa bcu po re re la gsum gsum mo/ /'bring pos ni bdun te/ tshogs sbyor gnyis la gnyis gnyis/ mthong lam du gcig sgom pa'i lam du gnyis so/ /rnon pos ni gsum ste/ slob dpon bha byas mdzad pa'i dbu ma rin po che'i sgron ma las/ dbang po rnon po ni bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya la/ dbang po 'bring po ni bskal pa grangs med pa bdun gyis so/ /dbang po rtul po ni bskal pa grangs med pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyis so zhes pa'i rnon po'i gsum ni/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ grangs med gsum ni rdzogs pa yis/ /sgom pa yi ni tshar phyin te/ /zhes pa dang*/ brgyad stong 'grel chen las/ grangs med pa dang po ni tshogs kyi lam nas brtsams te sa dang po'i bar du rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni sa dri ma med pa nas bdun pa'i bar ro/ /gsum pa ni sa mi g.yo ba nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du'o zhes pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ tshogs sbyor gnyis su gcig dang*/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar du gcig dang*/ dag pa sa gsum du gcig ces bshad do/ /de'ang zhing gi mi tshun chad zhing du brtsi ba ltar/ sa dang po tshun chad tshogs sbyor du grangs med bshad pa'i tshul sa sde'i de dang don la gcig go /de ltar bshad pa'i grangs med kyang dbang po rno rtul gyis bzhag la/ rnon po'i grangs med gsum yang tshogs gnyis kyi rim pa bags kyis snyoms par gsog pa zhig gi dbang du byas kyi/ yang sems stobs che na skad cig re re la tshogs bskal pa mang po bzlums par bshad pas grangs med gsum ji lta bar gsog mi dgos shing*/

gsang sngags las dbang po shin tu rnon po'i dbang du byas te sems stob chen pos tshogs dpag tu med pa skad cig re re la bzlums pa can la rgyun chags su slob pas myur du tshe gcig la sogs pas grol bar 'thad pa yin no/ /de yang dbang bskur ba thob nas rim gnyis bsgom pa la zhugs pa ni tshogs lam chung ngur chud pa'o/ /de nas brtson pa dang thabs chen pos 'bad na tshe de nyid la mthong lam thob par gsungs la/ mthong lam thob nas skye 'chi med pas tshe de nyid kyis sgom lam mthar phyin te byang chub thob par byed do/ /de'ang mthong lam thob nas 'dod na zhag bdun gyis kyang byang chub 'grub par/ nyi khri las/ chos rnams la chos kyi mig rnam par dag pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po des 'dod na zhag bdun gyis kyang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya la zhes so/ /de phan chad ni rang dbang 'byor pa'i phyir ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar 'grub pas na ci dgar zad do/ /nyan rang theg chen du zhugs pa'ang 'phags pa'i lus des byang chub mngon du byed par gsungs so/ /de bas na gsang sngags kyi tshul tshe gcig gis grol ba la mang na bgrang bar 'os pa ma yin no/ /'di ltar sngags ni thabs zab la mang bas myur du mthong lam thob par byed pa yin la/ mthong lam tshun chad du thabs dang brtson pa'i khyad zhugs so/ /de yan chad du dbang po shin du rnon po'i sems dpa' dang*/ sngags kyi rigs 'dzin sa bgrod pa'i dus la khyad med par bshad do/ /rtul po rnams las sngags la spyod pa'i rigs 'dzin 'phags pas myur du grol ba yin no/ /'jig rten na'ang brtson 'grus dang thabs che ba shes rab che ba zhig gis bya ba myur du 'grub pa dang*/ phal pa rnams kyis mi 'grub pas kyang dpe go bar byas mod/ /gcig tu na gzhan du bgrod pa ma yin gyi/ nang du sems nyid 'od gsal ba la dri ma sbyong ba tsam las gzhi ma grub pa bsgrub pa ma yin pas kyang nye bar 'grub pa yin no zhes rgyud las bshad do/

/ gsar du 'khrungs pa la dga' ba bskyed tshul bshad pa ni/ byang chub kyi sems dam pa/ 'di ni snying rje'i ljon shing snying po can/ /'gro ba'i khur chen legs par khyer ba ni/ /tshangs sogs 'jig rten na yang sngon med cing*/ /rang gi phyir yang rmi lam ma rmis na/ /gzhan phyir smos ci 'tshal ba'i byang chub sems/ /snga na med pa 'khrungs la dga' ba bskyed/ /de yang*/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing*/ /snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang*/ / byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /de phyir thog mar snying rje bsngags par bgyi/ /zhes pa'i tshul ltar snying rje'i ljon shing 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i bya tshogs bstan pa'i khur bsnams pa de dag gis byang chub kyi sems dam pa de ni bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i pha ma la sogs pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi bdag po tshangs pa la sogs pa la'ang med la/ rang la'ang de snga phan chad tshe 'di gnyer ba tsam las/ de 'dra'i sems sngar med skyes pa la spro bar bya'o zhes/ spyod 'jug las/ pha 'am yang na ma yang rung*/ /su la 'di 'dra'i phan sems yod/ /lha dang dra srong rnams kyang rung*/ /tshangs pa la yang 'di yod dam/ /sems can de dag nyid la sngon/ /rang gi don du 'di 'dri'i sems/ /rmi lam du yang ma rmis na/ /gzhan gyi don du ga la skye/ / gzhan dag rang gi don du yang*/ /mi 'byung sems can don sems gang*/ / rin chen sems kyi khyad par 'di/ /snga na med pa'i rmad cig 'khrungs/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i sems rmad du byung ba de nyid rang gzhan gyi don gnyis bsgrub pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'i mchog yin te/ de nyid las/ 'di nyid de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes byed yin/ /rang don yang dag 'grub pa'ang 'di nyid do/ /'jig rten sdug bsngal sel ba'ang 'di nyid de/ /de bas bdag gis rtag tu 'di nyid bya/

/zhes so/ /de yang sems ma bskyed na sangs rgyas mi thob pas kyang sems bskyed par gdams pa ni/ ji skad du/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ byang chub sems ni ma bskyed par/ /sangs rgyas nam yang mi 'thob cing*/ /'khor bar bdag gzhan don bsgrub pa'i/ / thabs gzhan yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa blang bya'i cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ sngon 'gro la gnyis te/ mthun rkyen bsag pa/ yan lag bdun pa bya ba'o/ /mthun rkyen bsag pa la'ang drug las/ blang ba'i yul ni/ de bas na sems skyed par byed pa la rang stobs kyi nus pa yod na mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsams pa la len te/ 'jam dpal zhing gi yon tan bkod pa'i mdo las bshad pa ltar bya zhing*/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i cho gas kyang len pa'o/ /de'ang byang chub lam sgron las/ gal te bla ma ma rnyed na/ /de la gzhan sdom nod pa yi/ /cho ga yang dag bshad par bya/ /de la sngon tshe 'jam pa'i dpal/ /amba rā dzar gyur pa yis/ /ji ltar byang chub thugs bskyed pa/ /'jam dpal gyi ni sangs rgyas zhing*/ /rgyan gyi mdo las bshad pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'dir ni rab gsal bri/ /mgon po rnams kyi spyan sngar ru/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed cing*/ 'gro ba thams cad mgron du gnyer/ /de dag 'khor ba las bsgral to/ /gnod sems khro ba'i sems nyid dang*/ /ser sna dang ni phrag dog nyid/ /deng nas bzung ste byang chub mchog /thob kyi bar du mi bya 'o/ /tshangs par spyod pa spyad bya zhing*/ / sdig dang 'dod pa spang bar bya/ /tshul khrims sdom pa la dga' bas/ /sangs rgyas rjes su bslab par bya/ /bdag nyid myur ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /byang chub thob par mi spro zhing*/ /sems can gcig gi phyir yang ni/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar gnas par bgyi/ /tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /zhing dag rnam par sbyang bar bya/ /ming nas gzung ba byas pa dang*/

/phyogs bcu dag tu rnam par gnas/ /bdag gi lus dang ngag gi las/ /thams cad du ni dag par bya/ / yid kyi las kyang dag bya ste/ /mi dge'i las rnams mi bya 'o/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis sems bskyed par bya'o/ /gal te rang la nus pa med pa'ang bla ma las len par 'dod na/ sems rin po che/ de yang dge ba'i bshes las 'byung ba ste/ yid bzhin dag las 'dod dgu'i char 'bab bzhin/ nor bu las dgos 'dod kyi char 'bab pa ltar/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen las kyang legs pa'i chos thams cad 'byung zhing byang chub kyi sems skye ba'i rten du 'gyur ba'o/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems mnga' zhing de'i bslab pa la mkhas pas rjes su 'dzin nus pa ste/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ bla ma sdom la gnas shing mkhas/ /nus dang ldan las blang bar bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo*/ /zhes dang*/ lam sgron las/ bla ma bzang las sdom pa blang*/ /sdom pa'i cho ga la mkhas dang*/ /bdag nyid gang zhig sdom la gnas/ /sdom pa 'bogs bzod snying rjer ldan/ /bla ma bzang por shes par bya/ /zhes so/ / kun snod dag pa 'chos pa ni/ de ltar/ skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i bla ma yis/ /skal bzang slob ma spro ba bskyed pa ni/ /'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thar pa'i phan yon sogs/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge'i chos rnams dang*/ /byang chub sems kyi bsngags pa mtha' yas brjod/ /de yang sngar bstan pa'i tshul gyis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thar pa'i phan yon byang chub sems kyi bsngags pa rnams brjod la blo bsgyur bar bya'o/ / rten dgram zhing mchod pa bsham pa ni/ de nas sems bskyed pa'i/ gnas gtsang mchod pas mdzes shing nyams dga' bar/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs la sogs sta gon bya/ /gtsang khang brgyan pa dang*/ me tog sil ma dgram pa dang*/

dkon mchog gsum gyi sku gzugs bzhug pa dang*/ spos dang mar me la sogs pa'i mchod pa bsham pa dang*/ lha dang mi rnams mnyes pa'i yo byed tshogs par bya'o/ / tshogs zhing sprul pa ni/ de nas mdun gyi rten des mtshon nas/ mdun gyi/ nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rgya mtsho'i sprin phung bsam/ /de'ang spos dang rol mo'i tshogs kyis bsu zhing thal mo sbyar la zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las gsungs pa ltar spyan drangs te/ sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed do/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ /'di ni snod min sems can gang yang med/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /dus las mi 'da' thugs rje'i dbang gis na/ /sems can don la dgongs pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ / yid kyis sprul zhing bshams pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas ma lus gshegs su gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nas dkon mchog gsum byon te nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad gang bar bsam mo/ / de'i 'thad pa dgod pa ni/ de ltar bsam pas 'byon pa'i mthad pa 'god pa'i tshul/ 'di ni rang gi sems stobs dri med dang*/ /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rnams kyi thugs rje yis/ /ji ltar bsams pa de ltar 'grub par gsungs/ /ji skad du/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ gang zhig rgyal ba yid byed pa/ /de yi mdun na de bzhugs te/ /rtag par byin gyis rlob par byed/ /nyes pa kun las rnam par dgrol/ /zhes so/ /de'ang sangs rgyas la mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' bas gsol ba btab cing spyan drangs pa dgongs/ brtse ba'i thugs rje mnga' bas gzigs/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las mnga' bas rdzu 'phrul chen pos skad cig la 'byon nges pa yin no/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas la sems can gyi don las med pas bdag cag gi don mdzad pa'i slad kyis so/ /de yang zhal zas gsol ba'i don tsam la'ang thag ring mo nas 'byon na byang chub sems kyi bsod nams kyi mgron du nges par 'byon pa 'thad pa dang bcas pa'o/

/ spyan drang zhing khrus rgyan gsol ba ni/ snyan gsan dbab cing nam mkha'i dbyings su byon par bsams la/ de nas thal sbyar me tog snyim bkang nas/ /spyan drang bzhugs gsol khrus rgyan gos sogs dbul/ /nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dkon mchog thams cad rang gi gnas de nyid gzhal med khang pa stong gsum las lhag par bsams la/ padma rin po che nyi zla 'bar ba'i gdan la spyan drang ste/ rig pa mchog las/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ / bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes brjod pa'i tshe byon pa'i lam du khrus khang lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos brgyan par rin po che'i bum pas sku khrus gsol ba dpag tu med pas sku khrus gsol ba'i rjes la khrus ras kyis phyis te/ na bza' gsol bar bsams la 'di dag brjod do/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ / shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa dbul/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis/ /'phags pa kun du bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*/ /'jig rten dbang phyug stsogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi/ /stong gsum kun du dri ngad ldang ba yi/ /dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btsom byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ /zhes brjod nas/
gnas khang du gdan so so la bzhugs pa la/

yan lag bdun pa la'ang gsum las/ dngos dang*/ rgyud dag pa'i tshul/ bsod nams tshad med pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po yan lag bdun pa dngos la yang bdun gyi/ phyag 'tshal ba la gnyis te/ dngos ni/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ yid 'ong rdzing bu'i nang na gnas pa yi/ /'char ka'i padma kha 'bus bye 'dra ba/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar bstod dbyangs bcas/ / lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /de yang padma ltar thal mo sbyar te/ thar pa chen po las/ padma kha 'bus bye 'dra bar/ /lag gnyis spyi bor thal sbyar te/ /lus dpag med pa'i sprin tshogs kyis/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa dang*/ bzang po spyod pa las/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ / phan yon ni/ de'i bsod nams ni/ sa 'di rir bcas rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed du/ /bsod nams de 'dra 'jig rten gsum na med/ /lus btud dbang chen bar gyi rdul rnams dang*/ /mnyam pa'i grangs snyed 'khor lo sgyur 'gro zhing*/ /mthar thug zhi ba mchog gi go 'phang 'thob/ /'di ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i don du phyag 'tshal ba'i bsod nams dang mnyam pa ni 'jig rten gsum na med de/ legs pa tsam zhig don du gnyer bas phyag 'tshal na'ang bsod nams mang po 'thob pa'i phyir/ 'dul ba lung las/ dge slong dag /khyed kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la dad pas phyag 'tshal ba de'i rnam par smin pa ni/ ji srid du tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la khong khro ba ma skyes pa de srid du dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar gyi rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i bde ba myong zhing lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du phyin par 'gyur ro zhes so/

/ mchod pa la'ang gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa ni/ yan lag gnyis pa ni/ rang gis/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /mchod pa bla med rgya chen rnams kyis mchod/ / rgyas par bshad pa la dngos bshams dang yid sprul gnyis las/ dngos su 'byor pa ni/ de la dngos su bshams pa ni/ me tog spos dang mar me zhal zas chu/ /bla re 'phan lding gdugs dang rol mo'i sgra/ /rgyal mtshan rnga yab rdza rnga la sogs dang*/ /lus dang longs spyod mkho dgu'i yo byad kyis/ /'gro ba'i bla ma dkon mchog sras bcas mchod/ /'di dag kyang tshad med par bkod de 'bul ba ni/ spyod 'jug las/ thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i/ /me tog mandā ra dang padma dang*/ /utpa la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*/ /phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ /spos mchog yid 'ong dri ngad khyab pa yi/ /bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul/ /zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi/ /lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi/ /gser gyi padma tshar du dngar ba yi/ /rin chen sgron ma rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes pa dang*/ rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can/ khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang*/ /rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes so/ / yid kyi sprul pa la lnga las/ lha rdzas kyi mchod pa ni/ yid las byung ba ni/ sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa/ lha sogs 'jig rten kun na yid 'ong ba'i/ /gzhal med khang brtsegs rin chen dra ba can/ /glu gar sil snyan bstod dbyangs char 'bab cing*/ /rgyan mchog brgya phrag mnga' ba rnams kyis mchod/ /de'ang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad lha'i gzhan yas khang bstod dbyangs len cing me tog gi char 'bab pas gang bar bsam te mchod gnas dam pa rnams la dbul ba ni/ de nyid las/ gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong

ldan/ /mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba/ /dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang*/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes so/ / bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pa lnga ni/ gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dag pa rnams na/ rin chen ri bo nags tshal padma'i mtsho/ /ngang mo'i 'gros kyis gnyer ba de dag dang*/ /sman sogs dri zhim ngad ldang dpag bsam shing*/ /me tog 'bras bu dud pa'i tshogs kyis mchod/ /de skad du yang*/ me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*/ /'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*/ /rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du/ /nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*/ /ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*/ /shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang*/ 'dab stong g.yo bas bung ba bzung ba yi/ /lag pas gdu bu ku mu tas mtshan zhing*/ /sprin bral nyi zla'i zer gyis rab phye ba'i/ utpal la sogs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ /gzhan yang/ tsandan bsil ba'i kha yi sbubs bskyod pa'i/ /dri zhim ser bu bde ba'i ngad rnams dang*/ /phug dang brag ri sman ljongs nyams dga' ba/ /chu bsil rdzing bu gang ba rnams kyis mchod/ /de lta bu yang*/ de nyid las/ mtsho dang rdzing bu padmas brgyan pa dag /ngang pa skad snyan shin tu yid 'ong ldan/ /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo thog rnam pa dang*/ /gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang*/ ston ka'i mtshan mo dkar ba'i ri bong 'dzin/ /gza' bral rgyu skar phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ /nyin byed 'od stong dra bas mdzes 'bar ba/ /gling bzhi'i 'jig rten rgyan gyur rnams kyis mchod/ /gzhan yang*/ khor yug rir bcas bye ba phrag brgya'i zhing*/ /ma lus yongs bkod 'dod dgus 'byor pa dang*/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kun/

/blo yis blangs te thub dbang sras bcas mchod/ / bdag pos bzung ba'i mchod pa ni/ gzhan yang*/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i/ bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang*/ /nye ba'i rin chen bdun sogs rgya che bas/ /yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams mchod/ /de'ang yid kyis nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar 'bul ba ni/ 'khor lo dang*/ rin po che dang*/ btsun mo dang*/ blon po dang*/ rta mchog dang*/ glang po dang*/ dmag dpon rin po che ste rgyal srid bdun dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ dūrba dang*/ bi wa dang*/ li khri dang*/ zho dang*/ 'gi wang dang*/ me long dang*/ dung g.yas su 'khyil ba ste bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad dang*/ lh+wam dang*/ stan dang*/ bzhon pa dang*/ mal cha dang*/ khri dang*/ ral gri dang*/ pags pa ste nye ba'i rin po che sna bdun gyis mchod do/ / ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i mchod pa gnyis ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa ni/ bzang po spyod pa dang mchod pa'i sprin la sogs pa'i bkod pa bas ches lhag pa tsam du bsams te 'bul ba ni/ 'di ltar/ ting 'dzin yid kyis nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /de yang rnam pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ me tog sprin mdzes lding khang mdzes 'bar ba/ /spos dang sman sbyar bdud rtsi'i sprin phung dang*/ /gzi ldan sgron ma zhal zas rol mo'i sprin/ /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis mchod/ /tshul ji ltar na/ dkon mchog ta la la'i mdo las/ me tog phal cher me tog bla re dang*/ /me tog bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste/ /me tog sna tshogs kun du bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /lag pa'i mthil na mchod pa bsam yas rnams/ /rgyal ba gcig la mchod pa byed pa ltar/ / rgyal ba ma lus kun la'ang de bzhin te/ /drang srong ting 'dzin rnam 'phrul de 'dra 'o/ /zhes pa 'di phal po che na'ang yod pa ltar dang*/

bzang spyod las/ de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /ces so/ / thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod pa gnyis ni/ nang dang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ blo'i/ 'jug pa'i sprin can shin tu mtha' yas pa/ /sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar sogs/ /mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs sprin 'phro bas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus mnyes gyur cig /rdo rje gzugs ma dang*/ sgra ma dang*/ dri ma dang*/ ro ma dang*/ reg ma dang*/ phreng ba ma dang*/ snang byed ma dang*/ me tog ma'i tshogs rang rang gi mchod pa nam mkha' gang bas mchod par dmigs te 'bul zhing*/ gces par gzung ba'i lus kyang dkon mchog gi bran du 'bul ba nyid/ spyod 'jug las/ nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs par/ /yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun/ /blo yis blangs nas thub dbang skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ / yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis/ /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes/ /bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te/ / mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis/ /des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis 'dir/ /bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig / rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi/ /sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig / ces so/ / sdig pa bshags pa ni/ yan lag gsum pa ni/ bdag gi tshe rabs thog med dus nas goms pa'i bag chags kyis/ /las dang nyon mongs sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /srid pa'i rgyur gyur de kun bshags par bgyi/ /zhes pa ste/ 'dir sdig pa bshags pa'i tshul bshad pa la rnam pa bzhi las/ dang po sbyang bya sdig pa'i sgo drug ni/ lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum ste/

yul pha ma dang*/ mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon la sogs pa la/ dus thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar/ ngo bo mi dge ba bcu la sogs pa rang bzhin gyi sdig pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba yin na/ phyi dro'i kha zas la sogs pa bcas pa dang 'gal ba thams cad de/ bzang spyod las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang*/ /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /zhes so/ /sbyor ba rang gis byas pa'am/ gzhan byed du bcug pa'am/ byed pa la yi rang ba'i sdig pa'o/ /sdig pa'i byed las ni/ mtho ris dang thar pa la sgrib cing ngan song du sdug bsngal bar byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa sbyong tshul gnyen po stobs bzhi ni/ mi dge ba la 'gyod pa mang ba rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang*/ mi dge ba byas dus slar brtson pas dge ba la spyod pa gnyen po kun du spyod pa'i stobs dang*/ sdom pa blangs nas sdig pa mi byed pa sor chud pa'i stobs dang*/ dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub kyi sems bsten nas sdig pa zad cing bsrabs par byed pa rten gyi stobs te/ chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo las/ byams pa/ byang chub sems dpa' chos bzhi dang ldan na sdig pa byas shing bsags pa thams cad zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rnam par sun 'byin pa kun du spyod pa dang*/ gnyen po kun du spyod pa dang*/ sor chud pa'i stobs dang*/ rten gyi stobs so/ /de la dang po ni mi dge ba'i las spyod na'ang de la 'gyod pa mang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni mi dge ba'i las byas kyang dge ba'i las la shin tu brtson pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ sdom pa yang dag par blangs nas sdig pa mi byed pa'i sdom pa thob pa yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems mi gtong ba yin no zhes so/ /gsum pa sbyong tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum ni/

sbyor ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bsams la skyabs 'gro bya/ dngos gzhi sdig pa thams cad dran zhing 'gyod pas rang gzhan gyi sdig pa thams cad lce thog tu nag ling nger bsams la bshags pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer byung ste 'phral la dag par bsam/ rjes 'od zer mang du byung nas sdig pa thams cad dag lus shel gong ltar gyur par bsam mo/ /tshig kyang*/ bzang spyod dam spyod 'jug las/ phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ / thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas/ /tshe rabs 'di 'am gzhan dag tu/ /bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa'am/ /bgyid du stsal ba nyid dang ni/ /gti mug 'khrul pas bdag non te/ /rjes su yi rang gang bgyis pa/ /nongs pa de ni mthong bgyis nas/ /bsam pa thag pas mgon la bshags/ /bdag gis dkon mchog gsum dang ni/ /pha ma'am bla ma gzhan dag la/ /nyon mongs sgo nas lus dang ngag /yid kyis gnod bgyis gang lags dang*/ /nyes pa du mas skyon chags pa'i/ /sdig can bdag gi sdig pa gang*/ /shin tu mi bzad bgyis pa ste/ /thams cad 'dren pa rnams la 'chags/ /zhes so/ /de'i rjes la sdig pa'i ngo bo ji lta bu gang na gnas so sor btags nas nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas dag par 'gyur te/ phyogs bcu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig 'gyod tshangs byed 'dod na/ /drang por 'dug la yang dag ltos/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /de ni 'gyong tshangs mchog yin no/ /zhes so/ /de'ang slob dpon gyis sdig pa'i nyes dmigs bshad/ slob mas phyag dang mchod pa byas te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ bdag gi sdig pa sbyang du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa'i rjes la skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed nas sdig pa lce thog tu sems su bcug la/

bdag gis dkon mchog gsum dang mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ pha ma dang*/ sems can gzhan dag la 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa de dag thams cad 'gyod tshangs drag po'i bsam pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar byang chub kyi sems yongs su bzung ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir mthol lo bshags so/ /slan chad kyang sdom par 'tshal lags so zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i rjes la dar cig stong pa nyid bsgom du bcug nas/ rten gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po byung lus ngag yid gsum dag par bsam pa'o/ /rjes la slob dpon gyis mthong sdom dri/ slob mas gtang rag bya'o/ /de'ang tshul dang po ni rang gi tshul dang*/ phyi ma ni gzhan gyi tshul yin no/ /bzhi pa de dag gis sbyong nus pa'i shes byed ni/ byams pa seng ge sgra chen pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ mi shes pas ni gang byas pa'i/ /sdig pa'i las ni bshags par bgyi/ /mkhas pas nyes pa bshags nas ni/ /las dang lhan cig mi gnas so/ /zhes pa dang*/ lung rnam 'byed las/ gang gis sdig pa'i las byas pa/ /dge ba yis ni mthar byed de/ /nyi zla sprin las 'byung ba bzhin/ /'jig rten 'dir ni de snang 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mdzod kyi mdo las/ pha ma dang rang sangs rgyas bsad pa yang stong pa nyid bsgoms pas rnam par grol lo zhes pa dang*/ las rnam 'byed las/ shin tu mi bzad las rnams byas pa ni/ /bdag la rnam par smod pas bsrabs par 'gyur/ /rab tu bshags dang sdom par byed pa yis/ /de dag shin tu rtsa nas bton pa bzhin/ /zhes pa dang*/ bshes spring las/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa las/ /phyi nas bag dang ldan par gyur de yang*/ / zla ba sprin bral lta bur rnam mdzes te/ /dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhi na/ /zhes so/ /

dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba ni/ yan lag bzhi pa ni/ 'gro ba'i bsod nams phung po mtha' yas la/ /rtag par bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /de'ang rang bzhin gyi dge ba la bsam pa thag pa nas yi rang bsgoms na dge rtsa mnyam pa nyid thob cing bsod nams tshad med de/ sdud pa las/ stong gsum ri rab srang la gzhal ba tshad gzung rung*/ /rjes su yi rang dge ba de ni de lta min/ /zhes so/ /tshul 'di bsam pa thag pas yi rang zhing bzang po spyod pa las 'byung ba'i tshig 'dis bya ste/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/ / rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*/ /'gro ba kunagyi bsod nams gang la yang*/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang*/ /zhes so/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba ni/ yan lag lnga pa ni/ ma lus skye dgu'i tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor bar bskul/ / de'ang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas nas chos mi gsung ba la tshangs pas 'khor lo phul nas gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag kyang gsol ba 'debs par bsams la/ gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul/ /zhes so/ / des ni chos spangs pa'i sgrib pa 'dag cing*/ tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du dam pa'i chos rgyud la 'dzin pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ / mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba ni/ yan lag drug pa ni/ ding nas srid pa'i rgya mtsho ma stong par/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs par gsol/ /sngon bdag cag gi ston pa la dge bsnyen tsundas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa de bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams gang dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed bzhugs pa rnams dang*/

bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa dag nangs kyi tha ma la mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams la/ ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bzhugs par gsol ba/ mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*/ /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi/ /zhes so/ /des ni tshe thung ba dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ gzhan gyis srog la 'tshe ba'i sdig pa 'byang zhing tshe dpag tu med pa thub par 'gyur ro/ / dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ ma lus phyam gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /de'ang rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'dun zhing bsgyur ba de sems bskyed pa'i rgyur bsngo ba/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*/ / rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /zhes so/ / de'ang bsngo rgyu ni rang gzhan gyi dge ba dus gsum dang 'brel ba thams cad de/ phal po che las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la/ /kun nas kun kyang bzang por red gyur cig /ces so/ /bsngo ba ni sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na ste/ yum bar ma las/ rab 'byor/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar bsngo bar bya yi/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang de las gzhan gyi sar yang bsngo bar mi bya ste zhes so/ /ched du bya ba ni sems can thams cad kyis byang chub thob pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ de yang sems can thams cad kyi phyir bsngo yi/ rang gis yongs su thob pa tsam gyi don du ni ma yin te/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sar ltung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro zhes so/ /rnam pa ni chos thams cad med bzhin snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu/

dge ba yang rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur shes nas bsngo ba ste/ de nyid las/ rab 'byor/ chos thams cad ni rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ dge ba yang rmi lam lta bu sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul gyis yongs su bsngo bar byas ste zhes dang*/ bzang pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang gis sbyin pa gang la btang*/ /sbyin pa ji ltar mi dmigs pa/ /sbyin pa mnyam pa de nyid kyis/ /bzang po la ni yongs rdzogs shog /ces so/ /dmigs pa'am zhen pas dge rtsa bden bden por shes pa ni mi bzang ste/ sdud pa las/ ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba/ /dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ ci ste mtshan ma med na byang chub bsngo ba yin/ /'on te mtshan ma yod na byang chub bsngo ba min/ /zhes so/ /des na dmigs pa'am zhen pa med par bya ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can/ /phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do/ /zhes so/ /bsngo ba rang gi ngo bo ni/ dge rtsa byang chub tu 'dun pas bsgyur ba'i blo dang*/ tshig khyad par can mthu bsdoms pa ste/ 'jam dpal zhing gi yon tan bkod pa las/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de ni de bzhin nyid du 'grub/ /ces so/ /bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi khyad par ni/ rgyu dge ba sngon du song nas tshig dang smon pa bsdoms pa ni bsngo ba/ rgyu dge rtsa ma song bar smon pa ni smon lam mo/ de'ang bsngo ba sbyin bdag gi sems kyi 'dun pa dang tshig gi nus pas byang chub la sogs par bsgyur ba yin no/ /deng sang slob dpon rnams kyis byed pa ni nges mi shes pa'i dbang du byas te/ gzhan du na dpang po yin pas/ bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis kho'i tshig gi rjes su sems phyogs pas 'grub par gyur cig pa'i mthun gyur brjod pa yin no/ /tshig kyang sa dang po yan chad bden tshig grub pa zhig gis gsungs pa bzhin bya yi/

gang rung rung ma yin pas 'dir de'i rjes su 'brang ngo*/ /bsngo ba 'grub pa'i dpang por mdun gyi nam mkha' sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin bsams la/ sngon rgyal po byams pa'i stobs su gyur pa'i tshe gnod sbyin rnams la rang gi sha khrag byin nas gsungs pa ltar brjod pa/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrug pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces pa la sogs pa bya'o/ kha cig rjes la stong pa nyid kyis rgyas 'debs byed pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/ des ci bya dmigs pa med pa'o zhe na/ rnam pa ma go bar snang ste/ dge ba yang rmi lam lta bu/ gsog pa po'ang rmi lam lta bu/ len pa po'ang rmi lam lta bu ste/ 'khor gsum du bden zhen med pa la dmigs pa med pa zer gyi/ dge ba ci yang med par bsgom pa'i stong pa ni chad lta yin pas lugs ngan par go bas spang bar bya'o/ /spyir gyi dge ba gang byed kyang*/ sbyor ba byang chub kyi sems dam pas zin pa/ dngos gzhi dmigs pa dang mtshan ma med pa'i shes rab dam pas zin pa/ rjes rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu'i bsngo ba dam pas zin pa ste/ dam pa gsum dang 'brel na thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba zhes bya ba sangs rgyas kyi lam mas rgyu byed pa min no/ /des ma zin na bsod nams cha mthun zhes bya ste rang rang gi dge 'bras lan cig phyung nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid du shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa de dag gis rgyud dag pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar yan yag bdun pa sngon du byas pa'i dgos pa ni/ dpe/ ji ltar khrus kyis sbyangs pa'i ras yug dag /tshon gyis bsgyur bas kha dog gsal ba bzhin/ de ltar sngon du 'gro bas sems sbyangs pa'i/ rgyud la dngos gzhi'i sems mchog gsal bar skye/ de'ang sems dam pa skye ba'i gegs su gyur pa'i dri ma yod na sems de mi skye zhing gegs dag na skye ba/

ras dri ma can tshos su mi 'gyur ba la btso blag mkhan gyis khrus ras sbyangs te tshos byed pa dang 'dra ba'i dgos pa yod do/ / gsum pa de yis bsod nams tshad med pa'i tshul ni/ yan lag bdun pa byas pa/ 'di ni bsod nams 'bras bu tshad med de/ /chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab/ /ji skad du/ dpal sbas kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gang zhig phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la/ /dmigs nas thal mo sbyar byas te/ / phyag 'tshal de bzhin mchod byed dam/ /bsod nams dag la yi rang zhing*/ / sdig pa dag kyang 'chags par bgyid/ /bskul dang gsol ba 'debs gyur pa/ /de yi bsod nams phung po ni/ /nam mkha' gang bar rtag tu 'byung*/ / zhes so/ / byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dngos ni/ da ni dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ sngon 'gro byas pa'i rjes/ de nas sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /lan gsum bar du skyabs su 'gro byas te/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyis/ /byang chub thugs bskyed bslab la gnas pa ltar/ /deng nas bdag gis 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems bskyed bslab la gnas par bgyi/ /ma rgal ba rnams bdag gis bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol bgyi zhing*/ /dbugs ma phyung rnams bdag gis dbugs dbyung ste/ /sems can rnams ni mya ngan 'das la dgod/ /ces pa ste/ de yang*/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog /dam pa'i chos rnams la/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog /'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la zhes pa gsum dang*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bco ldan 'das thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ sa bcu la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/

bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji lta sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis byang chub chen por thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ sems can ma rgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /yang na spyod 'jug las 'byung ba bzhin brjod de/ dgongs gsol gsum po sngon du btang nas/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag ri ma bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*/ /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*/ /rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /zhes pa lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ / rjes byang chub kyi sems gnyis la 'bad pa mdor bstan pa ni/ des ni byang chub sems dpa'i gral la 'khod pa yin pas/ bslab pa bsrung ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don bya ba la 'bad par bya zhing*/ de nas bzung ste dus rtag par yang*/ cho ga de ltar nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /byang chub sems gnyis bskyed pa la 'bad par bya/ /de'ang byang chub kyi sems gso ba dang*/ gsal thebs pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa du ma yod do/ / bzhi pa brjod pa gsum gyi dgos pa ni/ cho ga de'i/ brjod pa dang pos smon pa sems bskyed la/ /gnyis pas 'jug pa sems bskyed gsum pa yis/ /gnyis ka brtan zhing dag pa thob par 'gyur/ /de skad du/ rgya mtsho sprin las/ de la brjod pa dang po dang gnyis pa dang gsum pa dag gis smon pa dang 'jug pa dang gnyis ka ches brtan pa'i mchog nyid thob par 'gyur te zhes so/

/de yang smon 'jug gi ngo bo gcig tu skye ba yin gyi dngos po tha dad pa ni med do/ /cho ga las tha dad pa ltar sbyar ba yang ldog pa tha dad pa gsum brjod pa gsum las skye ba yin gyi/ ngo bo tha dad pa ma yin te/ blo rdzas gcig dus gcig byed pa gcig pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ smon pa dang 'jug pa 'di gnyis ni/ ngo bo dbyer med pas gzhan gyi don du byed pa gcig pa nyid dang*/ tha mi dad pa'i rang bzhin du shes par bya ba nyid do zhes so/ / lnga pa dga' ba bsgom pa ni/ de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa thob pa'i dus/ deng nas bdag ni 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i ming yang 'thob/ /srid na mi 'jigs 'gro ba'i don byed cing*/ /rtag tu phan pa 'ba' zhig lhur len pas/ /mi yi srid pa don dang bcas par gyur/ /'di ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa thob pa'i skad cig de nas bzung ste sems de ma nyams par yod pa de srid du byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ste/ rang gi rigs dge ba nyams par mi bya zhing 'phel bar bya ba dang*/ dga' ba tshad med pa bsgom pa dang*/ sems can gyi don dngos sam brgyud nas bya zhing*/ mi nus na'ang smon pa bya dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ de ltar blo dang ldan pa yis/ /rab dang byang chub sems bzung nas/ /mjug dang rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ /sems ni 'di ltar gzengs bstod de/ /deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par 'thob/ /di ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*/ /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /long bas phyag dar phung po las/ /ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin ji zhig ltar stes na/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la skyes/

/zhes so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ming la rnam grangs du zhe na bcu drug yod de/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /blo ldan nyid dang gsal ba'i mchog /rgyal sras rgyal ba'i gzhi dang ni/ /rgyal byed rgyal ba'i myu gu dang*/ / rtsal ldan dang ni 'phags mchog dang*/ /ded dpon dang ni grags mchog dang*/ /snying rje can dang bsod nams che/ /dbang phyug de bzhin chos dang ldan/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sems bskyed pa thob ma thag pa de la byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon yang rgyas par brjod do/ /de'ang sdong po bkod pa'i le'u bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa las/ nor bzang gis 'jam dpal la thugs bskyed nas/ de'i bslab bya btsal ba'i phyir lho phyogs nas lho phyogs su phyin pa na/ byams chen lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram rnam par snang mdzad kyis brgyan pa'i snying po can zhes bya ba'i khang bzangs na 'khor byang chub sems dpa' 'bum phrag du mas bskor ba la chos ston pa/ nor bzang gis dpag tshad lnga brgya'i rgyang nas mthong ste dga' ba dang mgu ba dang rangs pas phyag byas pa byams pas gzigs nas phyag g.yas pa brkyang pa nor bzang gi spyi bor bzhag ste/ 'khor rnams la ngom pa'i tshul gyis nor bzang gi bsngags pa brjod pa/ ltos shig bsam pa yongs su dag pa 'di/ /nor bzang nor ni rab tu brtan pa'i bu/ /byang chub spyod pa dam pa yongs tshol zhing*/ /mkhas pa nga yi drung du nye bar 'ongs/ /zhes pa dang*/ legs par 'ongs sam snying rje byams byung khyod/ /byams pa'i dkyil 'khor yangs par legs 'ongs sam/ /legs par 'ongs sam blta na rab zhi ba/ /spyad pa spyod tshe dub par ma gyur tam/ / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa dang*/ nor bzang gis thal mo sbyar te zhus pa/ 'phags pa/ bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs na/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal bas bstan du gsol zhes zhus pa'i lan du/

rigs kyi bu/ khyod ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su gzung ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu/ byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi sa bon lta bu'o/ / 'gro ba thams cad kyi chos dkar po rnam par 'phel ba'i zhing lta bu'o zhes pa nas rtsi dang nor bu'i dpe'i bar du phan yon phyed dang sum brgyar nye ba dngos su gsungs nas/ phan yon de dag dang gzhan yang tshad med pa dang ldan no zhes gsungs te/ rgyas par mdo nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /

drug pa bslab bya'i rim pa la gsum ste/ skabs su bab pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar sems bskyed pa'i rjes thogs su de'i bslab pa la ji ltar nan tan du bya ba'i rim pa brjod par bya ste/ skabs su bab pa'i tshul/ de ni sems gtsang dge ba'i sa gzhi la/ / byang chub sems gnyis myu gu rab bskyed de/ /de gzung dag pa spel phyir brtson par bya/ /'od gsal ba'i sems la slar yang byang chub tu sems bskyed pas ches dag pa nyid du 'gyur te/ bdud dang phyir rgol ba dag gis bar du gcod par mi nus te/ chos bcu pa'i mdo las/ nor bu rin chen rang bzhin gyis/ /'od 'bar 'byung gnas nyid du 'dug /byi dor byas na de bas ni/ /nyis 'gyur nyid du mdzes pa ltar/ /de bzhin rigs dang ldan pa yang*/ /byang chub sems ni tshol byed de/ /mtha' gnyis rnam par dag pa yi/ /spyod yul du ni bdud mi 'byung*/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i sems kyi myu gu skyes nas sems de mi nyams par gzung ba dang*/ dri ma dag par bya ba dang*/ dge ba spel ba'i thabs kho na la 'bad par bya'o/ /de dag kyang sems mchog tu bsrung ba'i brtul zhugs gtso bor bslab pas 'grub ste/ spyod 'jug las/ de ltar bdag gis sems 'di ni/ /legs gzung legs par bsrung bar bya/ /sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa/ /brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ bslab pa bsrung bar 'dod pa yis/ / rab tu bsgrims nas sems bsrung ste/ /sems 'di bsrung bar ma byas nas/ /bslab pa bsrung bar yong mi nus/ /sems kyi glang po yan btang pas/ /mnar med gnod pa byed pa ltar/ /glang chen ma thul myos pa yis/ / 'di ni de 'dra'i gnod mi byed/ /kun nas dran pa'i thag pa yis/ /sems kyi glang chen dam btags na/ /'jigs pa thams cad med 'gyur zhing*/ /dge ba thams cad lag tu 'ong*/ /zhes so/ / bdag gzhan brje ba la sogs rgya cher bshad pa ni/ da ni tshul ji ltar gzung ba dang*/

dag pa dang*/ spel bar bya zhe na/ rgyas par bshad pa/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bdag gis blang bya zhing*/ /bdag gis de bas 'gro ba bder gyur te/ /byang chub bar du de dang mi 'bral shog /snyam du gtong len spel mar sbyang bya zhing*/ /smon pa'i bslab bya tshad med bzhi po bsgom/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs spangs sems bsrung bya/ /'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol phyin drug spyad/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs spang brtson par bya/ /de la smon pa dang 'jug pa'i rang bzhin la gnas pa ni sems gzung pa'o/ /de'i mi mthun phyogs spang pa'i phyir 'bad pa ni dag par bya'o/ /bdag gi bde ba dang sems can gyi sdug bsngal brje ba la spel mar bya ba ni sems spel ba'o/ /'di ltar spro ba dang*/ dge ba'i tshogs mang du bsten pa dang*/ kun du dge ba 'ba' zhig pa dang*/ sems can thams cad bdag nyid kyis khur du 'khur pa dang*/ bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa dang*/ bdag dang gzhan du brje bar bya ba ni bslab pa'i mdo bsdus pa ste/ spyod 'jug las/ sgyid lug med dang dpung tshogs dang*/ /lhur blang bdag nyid dbang bya dang*/ /bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa dang*/ /gzhan dang bdag tu brje bar gyis/ /zhes so/ de la phyogs dang po sems can gyi don dang*/ byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs po che thos pa na/ bdag lta bus ga la nus snyam du sgyid lug pa med pas brtson par bya ba yang gzhi shes pas bzhag go /de yang sems can dman pa rnams mi lus thob pa na bdag gis da lta nas brtson par byas na byang chub 'grub la/ dman pa de dag gis kyang byang chub thob par gsungs pa la bltas na ci dka' snyam du bsam pa ste/ de nyid las/ bdag gis byang chub ga la zhes/ /sgyid lug par ni mi bya ste/ /'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /bden par gsung pas bden 'di gsungs/ /sbrang bu sha sbrang bung ba dang*/ /de bzhin srin bur gang gyur pa/ /des kyang brtson pa'i stobs bskyed na/

/byang chub thob dka' bla med 'thob/ /bdag lta rigs kyis mir skyes la/ /phan dang gnod pa ngo shes pas/ /byang chub spyod pa ma btang na/ /bdag gis byang chub cis mi 'thob/ /ces pa dang*/ lag bzang gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ lag bzang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpas 'di ltar bslab ste/ seng ge dang*/ stag dang*/ khyi dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ bya rgod dang*/ khrung khrung dang*/ bya rog dang*/ 'ug pa dang*/ srin bu dang*/ sbrang ma dang*/ sbrang bu dang*/ sha sbrang du gyur pa de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur na/ bdag mir gyur bzhin du srog gi phyir yang ci'i phyir byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'i brtson 'grus ma nyams par bya snyam mo/ /lag bzang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpas 'di ltar bslab ste/ mi brgya'am stong gis kyang sangs rgyas nyid rtogs shing thob na/ bdag gis kyang ci'i phyir mi rtogs shing thob par mi 'gyur zhes pa dang*/ za ma tog bkod pa las/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po siṅga'i gling nas byung ste/ yul 'khor mo 'jig gi grong khyer chen po bshang ba dang gci ba'i gnas de na/ srin bu'i rigs brgya stong du ma gnas pa las/ de'i tshe spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po bung ba'i gzugs su sprul te sgra bung bung byung ste/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes smras pa dang*/ de dag sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes bya ba rjes su dran nas/ 'jig tshogs la blta ba'i ri'i rtse mo nyi shu ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom nas/ de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' kha nas spos kyi dri zhes bya bar gyur te 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skyes so zhes so/ /tshul gnyis su na sems can mtha' med pa dag bdag gi pha ma yin la/ 'di rnams bsgral ba'i phyir brtson dgos la/ 'khor ba'i gnas su nam zhar sdod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi cha cung zad cig brtson pa byang chub la byas na 'tshang rgya la/
