sngar yang de ltar ma byas pas 'khor/ da dung de bzhin byed na 'khor bar 'gyur bas brtson dgos shing*/ gzhan gyi phyir cung zad ngal ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa ltar na/ de bas mtha' med pa'i sdug bsngal mang la bzod dka' ba nges par bzod par bya ba'i phyir skyo ngal med par bya'o zhes pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ lus can dpag tu med don du/ /byang chub dpag tu med 'dod cing*/ /dge ba dpag tu med byed pa/ /de ko byang chub dpag med kyang*/ /dpag tu med pa rnam pa bzhi'i/ /tshogs kyis ring por mi thogs par/ /ji lta bur na thob mi 'gyur/ /bsod nams mtha' yas zhes pa dang*/ /ye shes mtha' yas zhes pa des/ /lus dang sems kyi sdug bsngal dag /myur ba nyid du sel bar byed/ /sdig pas ngan 'gro lus kyis ni/ / sdug bsngal bkres skom la sogs 'byung*/ /des sdig ma byas bsod nams kyis/ /srid pa gzhan na de med do/ /rmongs pas yid kyi sdug bsngal ni/ / chags dang 'jigs dang 'dod la sogs/ /de rten med pa'i ye shes kyis/ / de ni myur ba nyid du spong*/ /lus dang yid kyi sdug bsngal gyis/ /de ltar shin tu ma rmas na/ /gal te 'jig rten mthar thug par/ /'jig rten 'dren kyang ci ste skyo/ /sdug bsngal ba la dus thung yang*/ /bzod dka' yun ring smos ci dgos/ /sdug bsngal med cing bde ba la/ /mtha' yas dus kyang ci zhig gnod/ /de la lus kyi sdug bsngal med/ /yid kyi sdug bsngal ga la yod/ / de ni snying rjes 'jig rten na/ /de nyid kyis ni yun ring gnas/ /de bas sangs rgyas ring thogs zhes/ /blo dang ldan pa sgyid mi lug /nyes zad yon tan don du ni/ /'di la rtag tu 'bad par bya/ /zhes so/ /yang 'di ltar yun ring mor sems can gyi don du srid par gnas pa ga la bzod snyam na'ang ma yin te/ byang chub kyi sems yod pas bde ba yin gyi/ sdug bsngal ba ma yin pas kyang bzod dgos te/

spyod 'jug las/ bsod nams kyis ni lus bde la/ /mkhas pa yis ni sems bde na/ /gzhan don 'khor bar gnas kyang ni/ /snying rje can dag ci ste skyo/ /'di ni byang chub sems stobs kyis/ /sngon gyi sdig pa zad byed cing*/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho sdud byed phyir/ /nyan thos rnams las mchog tu bshad/ /de bas skyo ngal kun sel ba'i/ /byang chub sems kyi rta zhon nas/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ / sems shes su zhig sgyid lug 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /yang sems can thams cad sgyu ma dang ri mo dang nam mkha'i rang bzhin can ye nas ma skyes la snang bas don bya ba bden par dgos pa med pas kyang spro bar bya ste/ bshes spring las/ sems ni chu dang sa dang rdo ba dang*/ /ri mo bris pa de 'drar rig par gyis/ /zhes pa dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ dper na nam mkha'i khams ni bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las lhag pa 'das par gyur kyang skyo zhing yi chad pa med de/ nam mkha'i khams la skye ba'am/ 'jig pa'am/ 'tshig pa'am gyes par 'gyur ba med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nam mkha'i khams la dngos po med pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' gang gis chos thams cad dngos po med par shes pa de ni skyo ba dang*/ ngal ba dang*/ yongs su yi chad pa'i sems mi bskyed do zhes so/ /tshul de lta bus byang chub bsgrub pa dang*/ gzhan don bya ba la skyo ngal med par bya'o/ / 'di dag gi tshul gzhan yang*/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag las 'byung ba ltar bsam ste/ rnam pa bcu gsum gyi phan pa bsgrub dgos so/ /de gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyis bdag gi pha ma yang dang yang du byas par mnyam la/ de'i dus su brtse bas phan btags pa sha stag yin pas drin lan du bya bas kyang sems can gyi don bya dgos so/ /'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ sa chen po 'di ril bu sran ma tsam du byas te/

sems can gcig gi bdag gi pha dang ma byas pa'i grangs bgrangs na sa chen po 'di zad par 'gyur gyi/ sems can gcig gis pha dang ma byas pa'i grangs ni zad par mi 'gyur ro zhes so/ /gzhan yang*/ sems can gyis phan btags pa de dag gis lan ma gzhal na byas pa mi gzo ba'i khur chen pos non par 'gyur bas de bsal ba'i phyir yang sems can la phan pa bsgrub dgos par/ lung rnam 'byed las/ sa rnams dang ni ri rnams dang*/ /rgya mtsho bdag gi khur min te/ /byas pa mi gzo gang yin pa/ /de ni bdag gi khur chen yin/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/ /gzhan yang*/ sems can rnams bde zhing skyid na bdag gis phan btags mi dgos mod kyang*/ bdag cag gi phyir sngon sdig pa byas pas 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyis non pas na/ bdag gis lan pa'i nyes pa bsal ba'i phyir yang sems can gyi don bya dgos so/ /gzhan yang*/ sems can rnam bde ba 'dod/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod par gcig kyang*/ de'i thabs la rmongs pas sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig gis gdung pa rnams de las bzlog pa'i phyir yang sems can la phan pa bsgrub dgos so/ /gzhan yang*/ sems can dpag tu med pa sngar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis drangs pas ma lang zhing gdul bar ma nus pa 'di rnams bdag gis ma drangs na theg pa chen po'i rigs chad pa dang*/ sems can gyi mgon skyabs med par 'gyur bas kyang phan pa bsgrub dgos so/ /gzhan yang nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dbang gis nyon mongs pa'i rlung gis dkrugs te phyin ci log pas kyang gdul ba'i phyir 'bad pas smon lam 'debs par gsungs na/ ci phan du gzhan don bya nas kyang 'di yi phan pa 'grub par shog cig snyam du bsgom zhing*/ sems can gcig nas nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam gyi bar du bsgom par bya'o/ /bdag gzhan brje ba ni/ de la blo 'byongs nas/ rang gi bde ba dang dge ba ci yod pa thams cad de la blos lings kyis phog la/

de'i bsod nams kyis gnas skabs su mtho ris dang mthar thug sangs rgyas thob par bsam/ de'i las ngan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la tshur gos brjes pa ltar dang du blangs nas rang rgyud la smin pas kho'i don du ngan song la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mang po myong bar bsam zhing*/ snying khong rus pa'i gting nas brje ba de lta bu sems can gcig la blo 'byongs nas kun gyi bar du bya'o/ /des ni thog ma med pa'i sdig pa tshan po che 'dag cing phyi mar ngan song la sogs pa myong 'gyur gyi las mang po zad par byed pa dang bde ba du ma thob par byed pa'o/ /spyod 'jug las/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje bar ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing*/ /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ / ces pa'i don to/ /'dir kha cig na re/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas/ /zhes pas de ltar byas na mi rung ste/ bdag nyid gtan du 'khor bar ltung ba'i phyir ro/ /yang mi dge ba byas dus kyang byang chub tu 'dun pas bsngos na dge bar 'gyur te/ 'dun pa khyad par can yod pas bsngos pa'i phyir zhes zer ba'ang bdud kyi gsang tshig tu bas mod/ 'on kyang de 'dra ba'i lan bshad par bya ste/ 'di ltar gzhan don du phyi ma'i mu mthar smon pas 'khor bar 'khyams na 'jam dpal yang 'khyams par rigs te/ de'i smon lam las/ sems can re re'i phyir yang ni/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar gnas par shog /ces btab pa'i phyir ro/ /bdag gzhan brje ba byas pa yang sems can dang dngos su brjes pa ni med la/ yod na'ang shin tu bzang ste rlabs po che'i bsod nams yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yid kyis brjes pa'i sems can dang bdag gnyis ka rang gi sems yin pas kyang gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag la mi smin cing rang gi bde ba gzhan la mi 'pho ba yin no/ /'di ltar las 'bras mi 'pho bar gsungs te/ las brgya pa las/

rang gis byas pa gzhan la mi 'pho zhing*/ /gzhan gyi las kyang de bzhin rang la min/ /rang gis bsags pa'i bgo skal spyod pas na/ / sems can rnams ni las kyi mun pas bsgribs/ /zhes so/ /sdig pa ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ma yin pas bsngo ba'i rgyur mi rung ste/ ngan song dang sdug bsngal las gzhan gyi rgyu ma yin no/ /dgos pa yin no/ /gzhan yang*/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med kyang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rmi lam dang 'dra ba rnams snying rjes drang dgos te/ ma drangs na snying rje khyad du gsod par 'gyur bas kyang phan pa bsgrub dgos so/ /gzhan yang*/ bdag gis sems can gyi don byed par sems bskyed pa'i phyir/ don ma byas na rang gi bslab pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur bas kyang phan pa bsgrub dgos so/ /gzhan yang*/ bdag 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di yang sems can la khor khro la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa skyes pas lan/ da ni rang gi byang chub bsgrub pa'i yul sems can mchog tu gyur pas na yang phan pa bsgrub dgos so/ /spyod 'jug las/ 'di dag mgu byas mang po zhig /'di ltar phun tshogs pha rol phyin/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang*/ gzhan don dngos su byas pas rang don shugs la 'grub pa'i phyir yang phan pa bya dgos te/ de nyid las/ rang don yang dag bsgrub pa'ang de nyid do/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang*/ sems can gyi don byas na sangs rgyas mnyes pa'i phyir yang phan pa bsgrub dgos te/ de nyid las/ sems can mgu bya ma gtogs pa/ /rgyal ba mnyes pa'i thabs gzhan med/ /ces so/ /gzhan yang*/ sems bskyed kyang sems can la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ nyan rang du ltung bar 'gyur bas kyang sems can gyi don bya dgos so/ /gzhan yang*/ don dam par bdag dang sems can dmigs su med pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can gyi don dka' ba med pa'i phyir yang sems can la phan pa bsgrub dgos so/ / mdor na sems can gcig tsam 'khor ba las ma thar yang de'i bar du bdag 'khor bar gnas la don bya/

bdag gis nyin mtshan du skyo dub med pas brtson pa bskal pa bye ba brgyar byas na sems can gcig gi rgyud la sems dge ba skad cig skye bar shes na'ang sems stobs chen pos brtson dgos te/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rgyal sras brtson 'grus mchog la brten pa de/ /sems can tshogs rab smin par byed pa na/ /pha rol sems dge gcig gi phyir yang ni/ /bskal ba bye ba stong du'ang skyo mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis don bya ba yin no/ /dpung tshogs bskyed pa'ang rnam pa bzhi/ spyod 'jug las/ mos brtag dga' dang dor ba yin/ zhes pas dang po mos pa'i dpung ni byang chub sems kyi phan yon la mos pas dge ba bsgrub cing mi dge ba dor ba ste/ de nyid las/ mos pas sdug bsngal 'jigs pa dang/ /de yi phan bsams pas bskyed/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa brten pa'i dpung ni bdag gis sems ma bskyed na phar zhog /bskyed nas btang bas gang gi sgo nas kyang ngan par 'gyur du 'ong snyam nas bsran tshugs la ma shor bar byed pa ste/ de nyid las/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan cho ga yis/ /brtsams nas nga rgyal bsgom par bya/ /dang por 'byor pa brtags nas ni/ /brtsam mam yang na mi brtsam bya/ /brtsams nas bzlog par mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa dor ba'i dpung ni skabs 'gar ji skad bshad pa'i bslab pa phran tshegs sems can la mi gnod pa kha cig btang snyoms su bya bar gnang ba la brten pa ste/ de nyid las/ 'jigs dang dga' ston sogs 'brel bas/ /gal te mi nus ci bder bya/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/ /bzhi pa dga' ba'i dpung ni/ sems can gyi don dang bslab pa bsgrub pa la dga' zhing spro bas 'jug pa yin te/ slob spring du/ gang zhig gzhan gyi don du dbu rnams gcod byed kyang*/ /padma lta bur dgyes pa'i spyan 'byed gzigs mdzod cing*/ /nyid kyi don du gdugs dkar gcig gis khebs pa lta'i/ /sa yang ral gri so bdar rnon po lta bur dgongs/

/zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/ /dge ba ni lhur blang bya'am mtho ris dang thar pa'i rgyu yin pas rtag tu bya ba ste/ spyod 'jug las/ rgya che dri bzang bsil ba padma'i snying por gnas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung snyan zas kyis gzi brjid bskyed byas pa/ /thub 'od kyis rgyas padma las byung lus mchog can/ /rgyal ba'i mdun nas bde gshegs sras su dge bas 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ gang dag gang du 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de dang der ni bsod nams des/ / 'bras bu'i yon gyis dngos mchod 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'gro ba bdag gi dbang du bya ba ni sems can thams cad bdag gi pha ma dang nye dur ma gyur pa med pas 'di rnams kyi don bya ba dang*/ byang chub bsgrub pa'i zhing du gyur pas dbang du byas te phan gdags pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dgyes pa bskyed pas kyang dbang du byas la phan pa bsgrub pa ste/ de nyid las/ sems can rnams dang rgyal ba la/ /sangs rgyas chos 'grub 'dra ba las/ /rgyal la gus bya de bzhin du/ /sems can la min ci yi tshul/ /zhes pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs rnams dgyes par bgyid slad du/ /deng nas nges brtul 'jig rten bran du mchi/ /zhes so/ /bdag gzhan mnyam par bsgom pa yang*/ thun mong ba btang snyoms bsgoms pa'i nang du bshad zin la/ thun mong ma yin pa ni/ dgra lta bu zhig la thog mar ma'i 'du shes bskyed la/ rang nyid la gnas skabs su bde ba dang*/ mthar thugs legs pa grub na dga' ba bzhin du/ de la'ang khyad med pas/ bdag gis ci lung las kyang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ste zhes pa las/ sdig pa'i rtsa ba 'di bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ste zhes gang las kyang ma gsungs ba'i phyir ro/ / des na rgyu dge ba can 'dun pas gang bsngos pa der 'gyur gyi/ rgyur mi rung ba bsngos kyang mi 'gyur te nam mkha' 'di byang chub tu bsngos kyang mi 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /de bas na 'di lta bu'i lugs yid la mi bsam zhing thos par yang mi bya na dngos su bya zhing de'i rjes su khas len pa lta smos kyang ci dgos so/
/dag pa dang spel ba ni 'og tu da lta 'chad par 'gyur bas 'dir mi spro'o/ /

dran dang shes bzhin bsten pa'i tshul ni/ tshul de bas na nyin mtshan/ rtag tu dran dang shes bzhin bag yod kyis/ /mi dge spang zhing dge chos rgya mtsho bsgrub/ / 'di ltar don gsum gyis ni bslab pa rnams kyi gtso bo rang gi sems nyon mongs pa'i tshogs las bsrung ba yin la/ de yang dran pa dang shes bzhin dang bag yod pa gsum gyis sems bsrung bar bya'o/ /de la phan yon dang nyes dmigs dran pas mi nyams pa dang*/ rang gi ngo bo dran pas mi nyams par bya ba gzhu gdungs pa'i rgyud lta bu zhig kho na gal che'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ dran pa dang shes bzhin nyams na dge ba nyams shing mi dge ba skad cig la tshegs med par 'byung ste/ spyod 'jug las/ shes bzhin med pa'i chos rkun dag /dran pa nyams pa'i rjes 'brang bas/ /bsod nams dag ni nyer bsags kyang*/ /rkun pos btogs bzhin ngan 'gror 'gro/ /nyon mongs chom rkun tshogs 'di ni/ /glags skabs tshol bar byed pa ste/ /glags rnyed gyur nas dge 'phrog cing*/ /bde 'gro'i srog kyang 'joms par byed/ /de bas dran pa'i yid sgo nas/ /gud du nam yang mi gtong ngo*/ /song na ngan song gnod pa dag /dran par byas te nye bar gzhag /ces so/ /yang bslab pa dang*/ de'i phan yon dang*/ nyams pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi skyon yon la sogs pa shes bzhin rnam par dag pas kyang sems bsrung dgos so/ /dper na 'jig rten gyi rgan rabs dag sngar gyi legs nyes mang po'i rang bzhin la shes bzhin gyis bya ba ngan pa 'dor zhing bzang po la 'jug pa dang chos mtshungs so/ /'di ltar nyin mtshan du dge ba'i phyogs thams cad shes bzhin dang ldan pas bsgrub cing*/ rang gi sgo gsum la dge ba dang mi dge ba ji ltar byung brtags shing rde'u la sogs pas grangs byas te mi dge ba 'dor zhing dge ba la 'jug pa ni shes bzhin bsrung ba ste/ de nyid las/ lus dang sems kyi gnas skabs la/

/yang dang yang du brtag bya ba/ /de nyid kho na mdor na ni/ /shes bzhin bsrung ba'i mtshan nyid do/ / zhes so/ /de ltar dran shes bzhin gtso bo bsrung bar/ de nyid las/ sems srung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srog la bab kyang srungs shig ces/ /bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyor/ /zhes so/ /yang bag yod pas kyang sems bsrung ste/ rang la brten nas nyon mongs pa mi byed pa ngo tsha shes pa dang*/ gzhan gyis khrel gyis dogs nas mi dge bsrung ba khrel yod pa ste/ de gnyis ni bag yod pa'i ngo bo yin pas des nyon mongs pa bsrung ngo*/ /gzhan yang*/ nyon mongs pa las ldog cing thar pa'i dge ba spyod pa'i bag dang ldan pa nyid/ mngon pa kun las btus las/ bag yod pa gang zhe na/ ma chags pa dang*/ zhe sdang med pa dang*/ gti mug med pa brtson 'grus dang bcas pa la gnas nas dge ba'i chos rnams bsgom pa dang*/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos thams cad las sems bsrung ba ste 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang yongs su bsgrub pa'i las can no zhes so/ /de yang bag yod pa la gnas na dge ba dang legs pa kun 'grub cing mi gnas na mi 'grub la/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rtsa bar yang gsungs te/ bshes spring las/ bag yod bdud rtsi'i gnas te bag med la/ /'chi ba'i gnas su thub pas bka' stsal te/ /de bas khyod kyis dge chos spel slad du/ /gus pas rtag tu bag dang bcas par mdzod/ /ces dang*/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ sbyin dang tshul khrims de bzhin bzod la sogs/ /dge ba'i chos su brjod pa ji snyed pa/ /kun gyi rtsa ba bag yod 'di yin te/ /zhes pa dang*/ gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa'i mdo las/ de la bag yod pa gang zhe na/ ji tsam du dge ba'i chos rnams bsgrub pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bag yod pas ni byang chub kyi snying po mdzes par byed do/

/byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi rtsa ba'o/ /ye shes bsgrub pa'i chos rnams kyi gnas so/ / dge ba'i chos bstsags shing so sor 'dzin pa'o/ /sngon thos pa'i chos rnams chud mi gson pa'o/ /bsdu bar bya ba'i chos rnams sdud pa'o/ /sgrib pa'i chos rnams mi sdud pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /'di ltar dran shes bzhin bag yod gsum gyis ma zin na/ sngon yod pa'i thos pa la sogs pa'ang nyams shing*/ dad pa tsam dang*/ thos pa tsam dang*/ brtson pa tsam yod kyang ltung ba'i rnyog pas gos te ma dag pas 'khor ba dang ngan song las mi thar ba nyid/ spyod 'jug las/ shes bzhin med pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ /thos dang bsam dang sgom pa yang*/ /glo rdol bum pa'i chu bzhin du/ /dran pa la ni mi gnas/ / thos ldan dad pa can dang ni/ /brtson pa lhur len du ma yang*/ /shes bzhin med pa'i skyon chags pas/ /ltung ba'i rnyog dang bcas par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de'ang gnas skabs thams cad du rang gi sems la brtag cing rnam par g.yeng ba la ci nas kyang 'jug dgos na'ang de dang mthun pa'i dge ba'i phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa spros pa dang bcas pa lhur blang zhing mi dge ba dang ma 'phel bar bya/ dben par gnas pa na'ang bsam gtan la sogs pa don dam pa'i dge ba la 'jug cing btang snyoms su ma lus par bya'o/ / gang dang gang byed pa de nyid ma rdzogs bar du gzhan mang po la mi 'jug ste de nyid 'grub pa'i bar chad yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar sbyin pa lta bu'i dus su tshul khrims mchog yin kyang ma nyams pa tsam las de'i 'bad pa btang snyoms su bzhag la sbyin pa nyid la brtson dgos pa la sogs pa'i dus dang gnang bkag dang mchog dman shes pas dpyad pa gal che'o/ /de skad du/ de nyid las/ 'di ltar sbyin pa'i dus dag tu/ /tshul khrims btang snyoms bzhag par gsungs/ /gang zhig bsams te byar brtsams pa/ /de las gzhan du mi bsam ste/ /der gtang pa yi bsam pa yis/

/de nyid re zhig bsgrub par bya/ /de lta na ni kun legs byas/ /gzhan du gnyis kar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang*/ tsa na kar/ snga ma ma tshar gzhan bsgrubs na/ / gnyis ka mi 'grub ngal ba'i gnas/ /rkang pa ya gcig ma tshugs par/ /ya gcig bteg na 'gyel ba'i rgyu/ /zhes pa dang*/ snga ma las/ chung ngu'i phyir ni che mi gtong*/ /gtso bor gzhan gyi don bsam mo/ /zhes pa ste/ bslab btus su/ sman shing ljon pa nar ma son par bsrungs te/ son pa na gzhan la phan 'dogs pa ltar/ lus 'di yang 'phags pa'i sa ma thob bar du mi gtong zhing bsrung ba ste/ de nyid las/ snying rje'i bsam pa ma dag par/ / lus ni gtang bar mi bya'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ des mtshon nas dge ba chung ngu byas pas gong ma'i chen po 'chor na'ang chung ngu bzhag pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i dge ba yang gong nas gong du bslab cing 'doms na gong ma bya zhing 'og ma btang snyoms su bya ste/ de nyid las/ sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin la sogs/ / gong nas gong du khyad zhugs spyad/ /ces pa dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ gang zhig dga' ba'i yid kyis ni/ /lo brgyar sbyin pa byin pa bas/ / gang gis nyin gcig tshul khrims dag /bsrungs pa de ni khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis gnas skabs shes pas bsrung ba gces so/ /gzhan yang*/ nyin zhag gi chos spyod kyi rim pa dang*/ kha zas bza' ba'i rim pa la sogs pa dang*/ spyod lam gyi bya ba rnams kyang mdor bsdus pa tsam brjod par bya ste/ dang po ldang ba'i tshe na'ang dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub kyi sems rjes su dran pas langs te/ rmi lam du sdig pa mthong na yang de ma thag tu bshags shing dge na rjes su yi rang ba tsam bya ste/ nyin mtshan gnyis ka sems kyi bag chags su mtshungs pa'i phyir/ yum bar ma las/ shā ri'i bu/ gal te shes rab gyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyin par rnam par bsgoms pas 'phel bar 'gyur ba zhig na/ rmi lam du rnam par bsgoms pas kyang 'phel bar 'gyur te/

rmi lam dang nyin par la khyad par med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de nas sngar bstan pa'i cho gas sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa gzung bar bya ste/ nyin mtshan gyi cha la yan lag cung zad nyams pa yang gso zhing ma nyams kyang spel bar bya dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas kha zas kyi 'tshal ma 'tshal ba'i tshe na dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pas cha bzhi'i gcig de la dbul/ gcig glo bur du 'ongs pa la ster ba'i phyir gzhag / gcig 'phrog ma'i bu la sogs pa la gtor ma sbyin/ gcig rang gis bza'o/ /yang na cha gcig dkon mchog la/ gcig chos skyong la/ gcig rang gis/ gcig 'byung po lhag ma la dbang ba rnams la sbyin te/ spyod bsdus las/ zas la cha bzhir bgo bya ste/ /dang po lha la bshos gtsang dbul/ /de rjes chos skyong bsrung ma la/ /gtor ma shin tu rgya cher btang*/ / rang gis zos shing 'thungs pa yi/ /lhag ma 'byung po kun la sbyin/ /zhes so/ /yang na dam pa'i chos 'dul ba las gsungs pa bzhin cha gsum gyi dang pos dkon mchog gnyis pa dge sbyong ngam bram ze'am rgyal rigs glo bur du 'ong srid pa'i phyir bzhag gsum pa longs spyad do/ /de'ang bza' ba'i tshe zas la mi gtsang ba'i blo dang*/ skyo ba'i blo dang*/ srin bu'i rigs kyi grong khyer la phan gdags pa'i blo dang*/ snying po byang chub tu bgrod pa'i grub bo che dar cig tu gnas par bya ba'i blos bza' bar bya'i/ chags pa dang sred pa 'phel ba'i blos mi bza'o/ /de yang lus kyi cha bzhi'i cha gcig stong pa/ cha gnyis zas/ cha gcig skom du bshad de/ yan lag brgyad pa las/ lto ba'i cha gnyis zas kyis te/ /cha gcig skom gyi yin par bzhed/ /rlung la sogs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /cha bzhi pa ni yang dag bzhag /ces pa ltar ram/ yang na zas kyi gzhi las 'byung ba ltar/ cha gsum gyi cha gnyis zas dang skom/ cha gcig stong par bzhag go /de yang ltogs na srin bu'i tshogs la gnod pa dang nad 'ga' zhig ldang ba dang bya ba la 'jug par mi nus la/

'grangs drags na dri nga ba dang*/ nad mang du 'jug pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin las su mi rung ba la sogs pa'i nyes pa 'byung bar bshad de/ spyod 'jug las/ ran pa tsam du bza' bar bya/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis bza' bar bya'o/ /de nas rjes la mi rtag pa'i blo bzhag ste zas kyi bsngo ba/ lung las bshad pa bzhin/ rgyal po sbyin bdag nyid dang ni/ /gzhan yang grong khyer gnas pa yi/ /sems can phung po gzhan dag rnams/ /rtag tu bde ba thob par shog /ces brjod do/ /de nas 'gro ba na'ang*/ gnya' shing gang tsam du blta zhing lam gyi srog chags brtags pas sems ma 'khrul bar bya ste/ sdud pa las/ gnya' shing gang tsam blta zhing 'gro la sems 'khrul med/ /ces so/ /yang mig phab ste blta ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig 'ongs na 'dzums pas legs so zhes brjod pa dang*/ 'jigs pa'i dus na phyogs kun du blta ba ste/ spyod 'jug las/ don med g.yeng bar blta ba ni/ /nam yang bdag gis mi bya ste/ /nges par sems pas rtag tu ni/ /mig ni phab ste blta bar bya/ /blta ba ngal gso'i ched du ni/ /res 'ga' phyogs su blta bar bya/ /'ga' zhig mig lam snang gyur na/ /bltas nas 'ongs pa legs zhes brjod/ /lam sogs 'jigs pa brtag pa'i phyir/ /yang dang yang du phyogs bzhir blta/ /ngal sos kha ni phyir bltas nas/ /rgyab kyi phyogs su blta bar bya/ /mdun dang rgyab tu brtags byas nas/ /'gro ba'am yang na 'ong bya ste/ /de ltar gnas skabs thams cad du/ /dgos pa shes nas spyad par bya/ /zhes so/ /de nas shing drung la sogs par bsam gtan dang klog pa la sogs pa dge ba'i phyogs rnams bya zhing*/ 'ga' zhig chos nan par 'dod na'ang rigs pa ltas te/ khengs pa dang ma dul ba cung zad shes par smra ba dag la/ zla ba sgron ma las gsungs pa ltar brjod de/ bdag nyid chen po khyod lta bu'i/ /mdun du bdag gis ga la spobs/ khyod ni shes rab chen po ste/ /zhes pa la sogs pa brjod do/

/ci nas kyang nyan par 'dod na/ snod brtags te bshad do/ /de'ang blo chung ngu la chen po bshad na chos spong bas ngan 'gror 'gro ste/ sdud pa las/ thos nas blo chung de yis 'di ni spong byed de/ /spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro/ /zhes so/ /chen po la chung ngu mi bshad de/ spyod 'jug las/ rgya chen chos kyi snod gyur pa/ /dman pa'i chos la sbyar mi bya/ /zhes so/ /de'ang grogs med par bud med la gcig pur chos mi bshad de/ tshangs spyod kyi dgrar 'gyur ba dang*/ sgro skur gyi gnas su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de nyid las/ skyes pa med par bud med min/ /zhes pa dang*/ padma dkar po las/ mkhas pas gang gi dus su yang*/ /bud med rnams la chos 'chad pa/ /der ni gcig pur 'gro mi bya/ /dgod cing 'dug mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ / de'ang spyod lam gzhan yang der ma gus pa la sogs pa la mi bshad de/ spyod 'jug las/ ma gus pa la chos mi bshad/ /mi na bzhin du mgo g.yogs dang*/ /gdugs dang 'khar ba mtshon thogs dang*/ /mgo bo dkris pa dag la'ang min/ /zhes so/ /de nas phyogs yangs par seng ge'i khri brgyan pa la sogs par/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti la sogs pa'i rang 'dod med cing gzhan la phan pa'i blos 'chad de/ padma dkar po las/ gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su/ /yangs pa'i stan ni rab bshams legs bting ste/ /bzang po'i tshon gyis legs par kha bsgyur ba'i/ /chos gos gtsang ma de ni rab bgos nas/ /de la nam yang 'dod pa cung zad med/ /zas dang skom dang bza' dang bca' ba dang*/ /gos dang mal stan chos gos rnams dang ni/ /na ba'i gso sman dag kyang mi bsam ste/ /'khor rnams la ni ci yang mi blang ngo*/ /gzhan du mkhas pas rtag tu bdag nyid dang*/ /sems can 'di dag sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /'jig rten phan phyir chos gang bstan pa de/ / bdag gi bde ba'i yo byad kun snyam sems/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/

/de nas gang lta bu dang 'phrad cing gtam smra yang nga rgyal dang khyad gsod dang ma gus pa med pas 'dzum pa sngon du btang ste snyan par smra bar bya ba ni/ zla ba sgron ma las/ zla rgyas bzhin 'dzum dul ba dang*/ /rgan rabs dang ni gsar bu la/ /rtag tu gsong por smra ba dang*/ /des shing nga rgyal med par bya/ / 'jig rten yid du 'ong ba'i gtam/ /rigs pas dus su smra bar bya/ /sna tshogs g.yeng bar 'gyur ba'i tshig/'jigs pas nam yang smra mi bya/ /zhes so/ /de'ang snyan par smra zhing bstod pa ni rang la shor god med la pha rol gyi sems bde ba bskyed pa'i phyir te/ spyod 'jug las/ legs par smra ba thams cad la/ /dge bar gsungs zhes brjod par bya/ /bsod nams byed pa mthong gyur na/ /bstod pas legs par dga' ba bskyed/ /lkog na yon tan brjod bya zhing*/ /yon tan brjod na'ang rjes su brjod/ /rang gi yon tan brjod na de/ /yon tan shes par rig par bya/ /rtsom pa thams cad dga' phyir te/ /de ni rin gyis nyo na'ang dkon/ /de ltas gzhan byas yon tan gyi/ /dga' ba'i spyod pa spyad par bya/ /bdag la 'dir god 'ong med la/ /pha rol la yang bde ba che/ /nyes pas mi dga' sdug bsngal zhing*/ /pha rol du yang sdug bsngal che/ /smra na yid phebs 'brel pa dang*/ /don gsal yid du 'ong ba dang*/ /chags dang zhe sdang spangs pa dang*/ /'jam zhing ran par smra bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de nas rang bas lhag pa rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes dang/ mnyam pa rnams la grogs dang*/ dman pa rnams la 'khor dang*/ rgan pa rnams la pha ma dang*/ gzhon pa rnams la bu tsha dang*/ mnyam pa rnams la spun zla la sogs pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing gus par bya'o/ /chos bcu po'i mdo las/ lus dang ngag dang sems kyis gnas ngan len dang bral bas mkhan po la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa dang*/ slob dpon la mkhan po'i 'du shes bskyed pa dang*/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rgan rabs dang bar ma dang gsar bu rnams la zhe sa dang bcas pa dang*/

gus pa dang bcas pas bkur sti bya'o zhes pa dang*/ skyes rabs su/ dam pa rnams ni sus kyang mi bsring ste/ /dul ba'i tshul gyis bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ /de dang nye na de yi yon tan rdul/ /ched du ma bsgrubs par yang bgos par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ /de nas lkog tu nyes spyod dang bag med pa phra mo yang mi bya ste/ de nyid las/ ma mthong bar ni sdig pa byed pa dag /dug zos bzhin du bde ba ga la 'gyur/ /lha dang rnal 'byor can gyi mi dag gi /rnam dag mig gis mi mthong mi srid do/ /zhes so/ /de nas dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang*/ sangs rgyas 'byung dka' ba la sogs pa'i tshul yid la byed pas bag yod par bya ste/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten phan pa drang srong che/ /bskal pa bye bar brgya lam 'byung srid tsa/ /da lta dal 'byor dam pa rnyed pa la/ /gang dag thar 'dod bag med spang bar gyis/ / zhes so/ /de nas lus 'di chos bsrung ba'i phyir nad dang gnod pa las cung zad bsrung zhing gru'i blo bzhag pas/ zas gos la sogs pas ci nas kyang kles la ma bor ba de ltar bya ste/ don med par zlog sgom la sogs pa'i dka' thub ngan pas mi gdung ba nyid/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro dang 'ong ba'i rten tsam du/ /lus la gru yi blo bzhag ste/ /sems can rnams don bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yid bzhin gyi ni lus su bsgyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ bzhi brgya pa las/ lus 'di dgra ltar mthong mod kyi/ /de lta na yang de bsrung bya/ khrims ldan yun ring 'tsho ba ni/ /de las bsod nams chen po 'thob/ /ces so/ / de'ang mi rtag pa dang*/ byang chub la smon pa yid la bya ste/ gzhon nu ma bdun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa las/ 'dor bar 'gyur ba'i lus srog la/ /rtswa dang chu yi zil pa bzhin/ /ltos med yun ring goms pas na/ /bde ba chen po nam zhig 'thob/ /ces so/ /de'ang nor btang nas srog bsrung la/

sems bskyed pa la sogs pa'i chos chen po ni srog la'ang phongs pa med pas bsrung dgos te/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i mdo las/ bdag gis nor ni btang la lus bsrung ngo*/ /nor dang lus kyang btang la srog bsrung ste/ /nor dang lus dang de bzhin srog rnams kyang*/ /thams cad btang la 'dir ni chos bsrung ngo*/ /zhes so/ /des na sems la brtag cing skyon bltas la dor bas nyon mongs pas mi tshugs te/ tshangs pas zhus pa las/ sems kyi skyon rnams rab shes na/ /sems yod skyon rnams mi brten no/ /sems la dran pa legs gnas na/ /skyon med zhi ba'i gnas 'thob bo/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang*/ so shing dang mchil snabs dang bshang gci la sogs pa'ang dben pa skye bos longs mi spyod pa'i sar dor te mi mngon par bya ba ni/ spyod 'jug las/ so shing dang ni mchil ma dag /dor ba la ni dgab par bya/ /gci la sogs pa'ang longs spyod pa'i/ /chu dang thang la dor ba smad/ /ces pa dang*/ 'dul ba las kyang chu mgor zag pa mi 'dor ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ / zas kyi tshe'ang*/ de nyid las/ kha bkang pa dang sgra bcas dang*/ kha gdangs nas ni bza' mi bya/ /zhes so/ gang du 'dug pa dang*/ khyad par du bla ma dang*/ mang po'i nang du 'dug pa na lus kyi spyod lam mi mdzes pa/ nyal ba dang*/ 'phras pa dang*/ rkang pa brkyang ba dang*/ lag pa mnye ba la sogs pa mi bya bar drang por 'dug ste/ ci nas kyang mdzes par bya dgos pa nyid/ de las/ rkang pa brkyang ste mi 'dug cing*/ /lag pa mnyam par mi mnye 'o/ / bzhon pa mal stan gnas dag tu/ /bud med gzhan dang gcig mi bya/ / 'jig rten ma dad gyur pa kun/ /mthong thos 'dris pa spang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang mchong rgyug dang*/ lta bgad dang*/ 'jo sgeg la sogs pa rnam par ma zhi ba'i cha lus ngag yid gsum gang la yod pa thams cad bsdam zhing dul ba gtso bo bya ste/ 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud las/ glu gar rgyan po 'phen rgyugs sogs/

/kun la blta dang 'jug pa ni/ /nyes byas gdug pa'i khar son nas/ /tshul khrims srog la rgol ba'i rgyu/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu byang chub la ring bas spang dgos pa ni/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ yang dag ma bsdams rgod cing khengs pa can/ /ma gus nga rgyal ldan zhing chags shas che/ /nyon mongs zil non tha ba nyon mongs bcas/ /de 'dra dag la byang chub mchog rab ring*/ /zhes so/ /de yang rang nyid ma zhi ma dul bar gzhan 'dul bar mi nus pas thog mar rang nyid zhi dul dang ldan par bya ste/ yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa las/ 'ga' zhig rang nyid ma dul bzhin du rigs par ldan pa'i tshig smra yang*/ /rang gi tshig dang 'gal bar spyod pas gzhan dag 'dul bar mi nus zhes/ khyod kyis dgongs te de slad 'gro ba mtha' dag thugs la bzhag mdzad nas/ /re zhig bdag nyid ma dul ba nyid dul bar mdzad phyir brtson pa lags/ zhes pa dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ mi rgal bas ni bsgral mi nus/ /ma grol bas ni dgrol mi nus/ / long bas lam yang ston mi nus/ /grol bas dgrol bar byed par nus/ / mig ldan long la lam ston nus/ /zhes pa dang*/ chos bcu pa las/ ji ltar bdag sems can thams cad bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir brtson pa dang*/ sems can thams cad dgrol ba'i phyir brtson pa dang*/ sems can thams cad dul ba dang zhi ba la dgod pa'i phyir brtson par byed na/ bdag nyid ma dul ba dang*/ ma zhi ba dang*/ ma bsrungs pas ni bdag gi cha ma yin pas/ zhi ba dang*/ dul ba dang bsrung bar bya'o zhes so/ /de bzhin du gzhan gyis phan btags pa'i lan bya ba dang/ bdag la gnod pa byung na las dang byang chub kyi rgyur bya ba dang*/ kun gyi nang nas skyo ngal bzod pa ma lta bu dang*/ gzhan las yid dmar ba gdol pa'i 'du shes bskyed pas dal gyis 'gro ba dang*/ bya ba bsgrub pa dang*/ smra ba thams cad dran pa dang*/ shes bzhin dang bag yod pas bya zhing*/

gzhan la smod pa dang chags sdang gis kun du spyod pa rmi lam du'ang mi bya'o/ /nyin par gyi cha snga dro dang*/ dgung dang*/ phyi dro dang*/ mtshan mo'i cha'ang srod dang*/ dgung dang*/ tho rangs te gsum la phyag 'tshal ba'i phung po/ sdig pa bshags pa'i phung po/ bsngo ba'i phung po ste/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo byang chub ltung bshags lta bu 'don pa la bslab pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /phung po gsum pa gdon bya zhing*/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang bya ba dang spyod pa thams cad dge ba'i rnam pa 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar bya ste/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rgyal sras spyod tshe ji lta ji lta bur/ /dbang po'i spyod yul sna tshogs 'jug 'gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar rigs shing mthun tshig gis/ /sems can phan phyir de sngon 'du byed do/ /zhes pa'i tshul te/ rgyas par/ sangs rgyas phal po che'i spyod yul yongs su dag pa las gsungs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' khang bu'i nang du 'jug pa'i tshe sems can thams cad kyis thar pa'i grong khyer thob par gyur cig snyam du sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin du/ nyal ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi chos sku thob par/ rmi lam rmis pa na chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur rtogs par/ gnyid sad pa na ma rig pa las sad par/ ldang ba na sangs rgyas kyi sku thob par/ gos gyon pa na ngo tsha dang khrel yod kyi gos gyon par/ ska rags 'ching ba na dge ba'i rtsa ba dang 'brel par/ stan la 'dug pa na rdo rje'i gdan thob par/ rgyab brten pa na byang chub kyi shing thob par/ me gtong ba na nyon mongs pa'i bud shing bsreg par/ 'bar ba na ye shes kyi me 'bar bar/ g.yos zin pa na ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thob par/ kha zas bza' ba na bsam gtan gyi zas thob par/ phyir 'gro ba na 'khor ba'i grong las thar bar/ skas las 'bab pa na sems can gyi don la 'khor bar 'jug pa/ sgo 'byed pa na thar pa'i grong gi sgo 'byed par/

sgo gcod pa na ngan song gi sgo gcod par/ lam du 'jug pa na 'phags pa'i lam du 'jug par/ gyen la 'gro ba na sems can thams cad mtho ris kyi bde ba la dgod par/ thur la 'bab pa na ngan song gsum rgyun gcod par/ sems can dang 'phrad pa na sangs rgyas dang mjal bar/ rkang pa 'jog pa na sems can thams cad kyi don la 'gro bar/ rkang pa 'degs pa na 'khor ba nas 'don par/ rgyan dang ldan pa mthong na mtshan dpe'i rgyan thob par/ rgyan med pa mthong na sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par/ snod gang ba mthong na yon tan gyis gang bar/ stong pa mthong na skyon gyis stongs par/ sems can dga' ba mthong na chos la dga' bar/ mi dga' ba mthong na 'dus byas kyi dngos po la mi dga' bar/ sems can bde ba mthong na sangs rgyas kyi bde ba thob par/ sdug bsngal ba mthong na sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar/ nad pa mthong na nad las grol bar/ drin du gzo ba mthong na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la drin lan ldon par/ drin du mi gzo ba mthong na lta ba log pa la drin du mi gzo bar/ rgol ba mthong na phas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar gcod nus par/ bstod pa mthong na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bstod par/ chos kyi gtam byed pa mthong na sangs rgyas kyi spobs pa thob par/ sku gzugs mthong na sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba la sgrib pa med par/ mchod rten mthong na 'gro ba thams cad kyi mchod rten du 'gyur bar/ tshong byed pa mthong na 'phags pa'i nor bdun thob par/ phyag 'tshal ba mthong na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis spyi gtsugs bltar mi mngon pa thob par gyur cig snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o zhes so/ /gzhan yang don med pa'i rnam par g.yeng ba thams cad la skyo zhing mi rtag pa nyid yid la bya ba dang*/ sa ris dang*/ bab col dang*/ rnam rtog la sogs pas yeng thabs su byung dus dran shes bzhin gyis de ma thag dor nas lus ngag gi bya ba sems kyi rnam rtog thams cad chos su bsgyur bar bya'o/

/ mtshan mo nyal ba'i tshe'ang gzhogs g.yas phab/ mgo byang du bstan la nyal te/ 'chi ba rjes su dran pa dang/ dkon mchog gsum sngas su dran pa dang*/ chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la blo gnas pas nyal bar bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/ mgon po mya ngan 'das gzims ltar/ /'dod pa'i phyogs su nyal bar bya/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/ /gzhan yang nyin mtshan du/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam mam/ slob dpon gzhan la phan pa'i dbyangs sgom pa bas mdzad pa'i smon lam bdun cu pa sogs sku gzugs dang mchod rten la sogs pa'i drung du gdab par bya'o/ /de'ang tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu pas bstan pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ sangs rgyas dam chos dge 'dun dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang*/ / rnam kun btud de skyabs mchi na/ /mchod 'os rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sdig pa las ni bzlog bgyi zhing*/ /bsod nams thams cad yongs su gzung*/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams dag /kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /bdag ni spyi btud thal sbyar te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor slad dang*/ / 'gro gnas bar du bzhugs slad du/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol/ /de ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams dang*/ /bdag gis bgyis dang ma bgyis gang*/ /des ni sems can thams cad kun/ /bla med byang chub sems ldan shog /sems can thams cad dri med dbang*/ /yongs rdzogs mi khom kun 'das shing*/ /spyod pa rang dbang yod pa dang*/ /'tsho ba bzang dang ldan par shog /lus can dag ni thams cad kyang*/ /lag na rin chen nyid ldan zhing*/ /yo byad thams cad mtha' yas pa/ /'khor ba srid du mi zad shog / bud med thams cad dus kun du/ /skyes mchog nyid du 'gyur bar shog / lus can thams cad rig pa dang*/ /rkang par ldan pa nyid du shog /lus can kha dog ldan pa dang*/ /gzugs bzang gzi brjid che ba dang*/ /lta na sdug cing nad med dang*/ /stobs chen tshe dang ldan par shog

/thams cad thabs la mkhas gyur te/ /sdug bsngal 'jigs kun las thar zhing*/ /dkon mchog gsum la gzhol ba dang*/ /sangs rgyas chos nor cher ldan shog / byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang*/ /nyon mongs btang snyoms gnas pa dang*/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab kyis brgyan zhing*/ /tshogs rnas thams cad rab rdzogs te/ /mtshan dang dpe byad gsal ba dang*/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sa bcu dang*/ /dbang phyug dag ni thob par shog /bdag kyang yon tan de dag dang*/ gzhan kun gyis kyang rab brgyan te/ /nyes pa kun las grol ba dang*/ /sems can kun mchog byams pa dang*/ /sems can kun yid re ba yi/ /dge ba thams cad rdzogs bgyid cing*/ /rtag tu lus can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal sel bar bgyid par shog /'jig rten kun na skye bo gang*/ /su dag 'jigs pas skyo ba de/ / bdag gi ming tsam thos pas kyang*/ /shin tu 'jigs pa med par shog / bdag ni mthong dang dran pa dang*/ /ming tsam thos pas skye bo rnams/ /rab dang 'khrug med rnal ma dang*/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub nges pa dang*/ /tshe rabs kun du rjes 'brang ba'i/ /mngon shes lnga po thob par shog /sems can kun la rnam kun du/ /rtag tu phan bde bgyid par shog /'jig rten na ni skye bo gang*/ /sdig pa byed par 'dod gyur pa/ /de dag thams cad gnod med par/ /rtag tu cig car zlog gyur cig /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*/ /sman dang dgon pa'i shing bzhin du/ /rtag tu sems can thams cad kyis/ /rang dgar dgag med spyad byar shog /sems can rnams ni srog bzhin phongs/ /de dag bdag la'ang ches phongs shog /bdag la de dag sdig smin zhing*/ /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ji srid sems can 'ga' zhig kyang*/ /gang du ma grol de srid du/ /de phyir bla na med pa yi/ /byang chub thob kyang gnas gyur cig /ces nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du brjod na bsod nams tshad med pa 'thob par/

de nyid las/ de phyir sku gzugs mchod rten gyi/ /spyan snga'am yang na gzhan yang rung*/ /tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu 'di/ /nyin mtshan kun du lan gsum brjod/ /ces pa dang*/ de skad brjod pa'i bsod nams gang*/ /gal te de ni gzugs can na/ gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed kyi ni/ /'jig rten khams su shong mi 'gyur/ /de ni bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang mdo sde dag las 'byung ba bzhin bslab pas nyin mtshan 'da' bar bya'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dal 'byor rmi lam khung ltar yud tsam thob kyang*/ mi rtag pa chu'i chu bur dang 'dra ba 'di la lam sna ma zin na de nas mi zin pa'i phyir ro/ /

bdun pa ltung byed nyi shu phyogs mthun dang bcas pa bshad pa ni/ da ni ltung ba'i rab tu dbye ba bshad par bya ste/ de'ang sngar bstan pa'i tshul gyi/ byang chub sems gnyis mi nyams bslab bya ste/ /log par lta sogs rgyal po'i ltung ba lnga/ /grong sogs blon po'i lnga dang phal pa'i brgyad/ /thun mong gnyis te nyi shu ltung byed la/ / de dang phyogs mthun nyes byas shes par bya/ / de dag mi ldan ltung dang nyes med de/ /dge ba'i phyogs mthun bslab byar shes par bya/ /'dir nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ bslab btus su rtsa ltung bcu dgu gsungs te/ rgyal po la nges pa lnga ni dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor 'phrog pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i dge slaung la chad pas gcod pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba bslab pa las 'bebs pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa dang*/ log par lta ba 'dzin pa'o/ /blon po la nges pa lnga ni/ grong dang*/ ljongs dang*/ grong khyer dang*/ grong rdal dang*/ yul 'khor 'joms pa'o/ /phal pa la nges pa brgyad ni/ blo ma sbyangs pa la stong pa nyid ston pa dang*/ theg chen la zhugs pa phyir bzlog pa dang*/ so sor thar pa spangs te theg chen la sbyor ba dang*/ nyan rang gi theg pa 'dzin zhing 'dzin du 'jug pa dang*/ rnyed bkur gyi phyir bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod pa dang*/ rang gi zab mo bzod par smra ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor smin zhing len pa dang*/ zhi gnas pa'i nor kha ton pa la sbyin pa'o/ /thun mong ba smon pa'i sems btang ba dang bcu dgu/ de'i steng du/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'jug pa'i sems spangs te/ dge ba la mi sbyor ba dang nyi shu yin no/ /zla ba snying po'i mdo dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las kyang 'jug sems spangs pa nyid ltung byed du gsal lo/ /de ltar ltung ba de dag byung na ni byang chub sems dpar mi rung bas gso ba la 'bad do/ /sdom pa nyi shu pa las rtsa ltung bzhir gsungs te/

rnyed bkur gyi phyir bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod pa dang*/ sdug bsngal zhing mgon med pa chos dang zang zing 'dod pa la ser snas mi ster ba dang*/ bshags kyang mi nyan par khro bas 'tshog pa dang*/ theg pa chen po spang zhing chos 'drar snang ston pa ste/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po ni pham pa 'dra bar dgongs pa yin no/ /rnyed dang bkur sti chags pa yis/ /bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal mgon med gyur pa la/ /ser snas chos nor mi ster dang*/ /gzhan gyis bshags kyang mi nyan par/ khro bas gzhan la 'tshog pa dang*/ /theg pa chen po spong byed cing*/ /dam chos 'drar snang ston pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'ang slob dpon thogs med rjes 'brang dang bcas pa rnams ni rtsa ltung bzhir bzhed cing*/ len tshul yang sems dang ba las skye bar bzhed pas/ phyag mchod tsam la brten nas rgyud smin pa nyung zad la sngon du bar chad dri/ rjes bslab pa brjod cing*/ rtsa ltung bzhi po gang rung byung na bcos thabs kyang*/ sdom pa nyi shu par/ sdom pa slar yang blang bar bya/ /zag pa 'bring ni gsum la bshags/ /gcig gi mdun na lhag ma rnams/ zhes pa ltar 'dod cing*/ lan grangs kyang gsum las lhag pa blang du med par byang chub sems dpa'i sa las bshad do/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyi rjes 'brang rnams len tshul yang rgyud dag pa las skye bar bzhed pas/ yan lag bdun pa byas te/ tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la sngon du bar chad mi 'dri/ rjes bslab pa mi brjod la/ bsrung bya yang rtsa ltung bcu dgu'am nyi shu po bsrung zhing*/ bcos tshul yang nam mkha'i snying po la gsol ba btab nas 'chos la/ lan grangs ji tsam blangs kyang skye bar bzhed do/ /des ni srol gnyis po de ni sems tsam pa dang*/ / dbu ma pa'i lugs tha dad pa yin no/ / da ni phyogs dang mthun pa nyid bshad de/ de yang ltung ba de dag gi phyogs dang mthun pa/ dper na/ log lta'i phyogs mthun ma gus pa tsam ni/

nyes byas nas kun la shes par bya'o/ / de'ang log lta spangs pa'i sems dge ba la sogs pa ni ltung med ces bya la/ phyogs mthun gyis kyang ma gos pa ni nyes med du shes par bya'o/ /dge ba'i phyogs ji snyed pa thams cad bslab bya yin zhing*/ khyad par du gzhan don dang 'brel pa dngos kyi bslab bya yin no/ / brgyad pa smon 'jug so so'i bsrung tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ smon pa'i bsrung tshul dang*/ 'jug pa'i bsrung tshul lo/ / smon pa'i bsrung tshul la yang gnyis kyi/ mdor bstan pa ni/ da ni smon 'jug so so'i bsrung tshul bshad de/ de'ang dang po smon pa bsrung tshul la'ang spang blang gi sgo nas bsrung ba ni/ bslab pa ji snyed pa'i phyogs de dag gi rim pa/ mdor na nag po'i chos bzhi spang bya zhing*/ /dkar po'i chos bzhi dag la nan tan bya/ /zhes bstan ste/ rgyas par bshad pa la'ang gnyis las/ nag po'i chos bzhi spang bar gdams pa ni/ rim pa ltar dang po bzhi ni/ mchod 'os slu dang 'gyod pa med la bskyed/ /dam pa rnams la mi snyan sgrog pa dang*/ /'gro ba'i nang na g.yo dang sgyus spyod pa/ /nag po'i chos bzhi lags pas spang 'tshal lo/ /ji skad du/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i 'od srungs kyis zhus pa'i le'u las/ 'od srungs/ chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub kyi sems brjed par 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa slu ba dang*/ gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la sdang sems kyis skyon nas brjod pa dang*/ sems can la g.yo dang sgyus spyod pa'o zhes so/ / dkar po'i chos bzhi bsgrub par gdams pa ni/ dkar po'i chos bzhi ni/ dam pa bsten zhing yon tan bsngags pa brjod/ /sems can rnams ni yang dag dge la bskul/ /rgyal sras rnams la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas 'gro la phan bde byed/ /dkar po'i chos rab bzhi po bsten par

mdzod/ /ces pa ste/ brdzun spangs pa ni sems can la phan bde'i gzhir gyur pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa ni/ lam gyi grogs khyad par can du 'gyur ba dang*/ g.yo sgyu med par lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas pa ni dam pa bstan zhing bsngags pa brjod pas mtshon te/ dge ba mtha' dag gi rjes su phyogs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad theg pa chen po la dgod pa ni dge ba khyad par can byang chub kyi sems dang po bskyed pa la bskul ba ste/ de nyid las/ 'od srungs/ chos bzhi dang ldan na byang chub kyi sems brjed par mi 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ shes bzhin du brdzun du mi smra ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa dang*/ sems can la g.yo sgyu med par lhag pa'i bsam pas gnas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad theg pa chen po la yang dag par dgod pa'o zhes so/ /brtan bya'i sgo nas bsrung ba ni/ 'phags pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ gzhon nu/ 'du shes bzhi dang ldan na byang chub kyi sems brtan por 'gyur te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes dang*/ des bstan pa'i chos la lam gyi 'du shes dang*/ de bsgrub pa rnams la lam grogs kyi 'du shes dang*/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa'i 'du shes so/ / 'jug sems kyi bsrung tshul ni/ gnyis pa 'jug pa bsrung tshul gyi rim pa bshad pa ni/ rang don las kyang gzhan phan gtsor 'dzin pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab bya ste/ /gzhan don 'gyur na lus ngag mi dge bdun/ / gnang ba'i skabs yod don la dge ba yin/ /yid gsum nam yang gnang ba'i skabs med do/ /gzhan yang*/ rang don zhi bde 'dod pa'i dge ba yang*/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i ltung ba ste/ /gzhan phyir phan na mi dge gang lags pa/ /de yang bslab bya legs par rgyal bas gsungs/ / de'ang spang bya spong pa'i tshul gyis bslab pa/

shes bya shes pa'i tshul gyis bslab pa/ bsgrub bya bsgrub pa'i tshul gyis bslab pa ste rnam pa gsum yin la/ dang po la'ang*/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba shes pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa can dang*/ don med pa las gyur pa'i nyes byas las sems bsrung pa'i tshul dang*/ gnang bkag shes pa las bslab pa'i tshul bzhi las/ dang po gsum ni sngar smos zin la/ phyi ma ni mi dge ba bcu'i lus ngag gnyis kyi gnang ba'i skabs yod de/ gzhan don du 'gyur ba/ 'gyur bar shes pa/ rang gi dge ba de las che ba mi sgrib pa'i steng du 'phel ba gsum gyi gnas skabs brtags nas/ sems dpa' che la mi dge bdun gnang ngo zhes byung ba yin no/ /ci'i don du zhe na/ mi nag mdung thung can gyi mi mang po rang 'dod kyis gsod pa mthong nas/ ded dpon snying rje chen pos mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba las thar bar bya ba'i phyir srog bcad pa lta bu/ 'ga' zhig 'byor yang ser snas mi sbyin pa dang*/ mu ge'i tshe gang zhig srog la thug na/ gnyis ka'i don du phyug po las ma byin par blangs te dbul po la byin pa lta bu/ bram ze'i khye'u skar ma la dga' bas gzhan 'dod pas gdungs te 'chi nges pa bzlog pa'i don du 'dod pas log par spyad pa lta bu/ gsod nges pa thar bar bya ba'i phyir brdzun smras pa lta bu/ sdig pa'i grogs pos bslus nas ngan 'gror 'khrid pa las bzlog pa'i don du de gnyis phra mas phye ba lta bu/ mya ngan can gyi mya ngan bsang ba'i phyir gtam rgyud sna tshogs kyi sgrung 'chad pa'am bzhad gad bya ba la sogs pa'i ngag 'khyal lta bu/ sdig pa la 'jug nges pa bzlog pa'i phyir tshig rtsub mo smra ba lta bu ni gnang ba yin te don la dge ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ / yid kyi gsum ni nam yang gnang ba'i skabs med de mi dge ba kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig ni gnang pa'i skabs yod ces zer ba'ang sdom ma phyed pa yin te/ 'jam dpal dad pa log nas mu stegs pa'i nang du zhugs pas kun du rgyu btul ba'i tshe log lta skyes pa la ltung ba glengs pas/

med par gsungs pa lta bu zhes sbyor mod/ de'ang de ltar lus ngag gis kun du rgyu la log lta skyes pa skad bstan gyi/ sems log lta skyes na de dag la bar bar du dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan brjod par gsungs pa de ci la 'ong*/ des na yid kyi las ni nam du'ang ma gnang ba yin no/ /'o na lus ngag gis mi dge ba byas pas nyes par 'gyur te/ dug zos pa bzhin no zhe na/ sems dge ba dug sngags lta bus zin pas nyes pa med de/ sdom pa nyi shu pa las/ snying rje ldan zhing byams phyir dang*/ /sems dge ba la nyes pa med/ /ces so/ /'o na dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can gcig gi srog bcad kyang bar gyi bskal pa gcig tu nye tshe ba'i dmyal bar 'tshed par gsungs pas sdig pa nam yang mi bya bar gsungs mod snyam na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi bka' ni sems can gyi sems ky-i blo'i rim pa la dgongs nas/ res 'ga' gcig dang*/ du ma dang*/ nges pa dang*/ ma nges par gsungs kyang mi 'gal ba nyid du shes par bya ste/ gsung la bstod pa las/ gnang ba dang ni bkag pa las/ khyod bka' la lar gcig tu nges/ /la lar nges pa ma lags la/ / phan tshun 'gal ba ma mchis so/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis drang don dang nges don/ dgongs pa can dang ldem dgongs bzhi'i rim pa shes par bya ba gal che'o/ / 'di dag gi dbye ba rgyas par 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /shes bya shes pa'i tshul gyis bslab pa ni/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rgyal sras rnams kyi mi slob pa/ de ni gang na'ang yod ma yin/ zhes pa'i tshul gyis 'jig rten pa'i gtsug lag dang*/ gnas dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos ji snyed pa la thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ bslab pas nan tan du bya dgos te/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bya dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang bsdu na/ bzo rig pa dang*/ gso ba rig pa dang*/ gtan tshigs rig pa dang*/ phyi rig pa dang*/ nang rig pa ste gnas lnga la sbyang bar/

de nyid las/ rigs pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur te/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar gcad rjes gzung dang*/ / rang nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces so/ khyad par du bslab sdom gyi rim pa rnams shes par byas la bsrung ba gal che'o/ /de'ang sngar bstan pa'i tshul gyis/ ltung ba dang*/ ltung med dang*/ phyogs mthun dang*/ bslab bya dang*/ phyir bcos pa lngar shes par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba ni nyi shu'o/ /ltung ba de med cing dge ba la sbyor ba stung med do/ /phyogs mthun la dge ba'i phyogs dang mthun pa dang*/ mi dge ba ltung ba'i phyogs dang mthun pa'o/ /de gnyis kyi dbye bas nyes byas kyang gnyis te nyon mongs pa can dang*/ don med pa las gyur pa'i nyes byas so/ /de'ang bre mo'i gtam dang ltad mo la sogs pa la 'jug pa na chags sdang gis bskyed na nyon mongs pa can gyi nyes byas/ des bskyed kyang dran shes bzhin gyis ma zin par dgos med du 'jug na don med pa las gyur pa'i nyes byas/ gzhan gyi don du ma chags par 'jug na ltung med/ chags pas 'jug na de'i cha'i nyes pa ste phyogs mthun no/ /gzhan dga' ba tsam gyis 'jug kyang de nyid do/ /gnyen por mi rtag pa bsgom pa la sogs pa bslab bya/ gal te nyes pa mthong nas bshags bsdam bya bas phyir bcos so/ /yang dper bya na/ dge ba'i cha dang ma 'brel bar sa brko rtsa gcod pa la sogs pa don med pa'i nyes byas so/ / dge ba'i phyogs kyi phyir yin na ltung med do/ /don med dran pas ma zin bzhin du sa ris 'dri ba la sogs pa phyogs mthun/ dran shes bzhin gyis zin par bya ba bslab bya/ bslab pa dran nas phyir 'chos shing sdom pa ni phyir bcos so/ /de bzhin du lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba gang byed pa thams cad la sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /nyams na gso thabs kyang shes par bya ba las/

smon pa nyams na de gso ba ste/ de'ang nyams byed kyi rkyen ni/ zhum pa dang*/ sgyid lug pa dang*/ lam gzhan la 'jug pa gsum las/ zhum pa ni bdag 'dra bas gzhan don mi nus snyam na gtong bas/ de'i gnyen por dal 'byor thob cing sems bskyed pa'i dus 'dir zhum pa spangs te gzeng bstod pa ni/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ gang phyir sems can mir gyur pa/ /tshad med skad cig re re la/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob de'i phyir/ /zhum pa dang du blang mi bya/ /zhes so/ /sgyid lug pa ni lam gyi phan yon ma mthong zhing*/ dka' spyad kyi nyes pa mthong nas sgyid lug na gtong bas/ de'i gnyen por phan yon dang brod pa bstan nas bzod par gdams pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ de bas skyo ngal kun sel ba'i/ /byang chub sems kyi rta zhon nas/ /bde nas bde bar 'gro ba la/ sems shes su zhig sgyid lug 'gyur/ /zhes so/ theg chen las nyan thos kyi lam mchog tu 'dzin na'ang gtong bas/ de'i gnyen por nyes pa dang*/ phan yon bsgom pa gnyis las/ nyan rang gi lam rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ring ba ni/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gyis bla na med pa'i 'bras bu las bskal pa chen po brgyad khris ring ste zhes so/ /theg chen gyi phan yon tshad med pa ni/ snga ma las/ 'di ni byang chub sems stobs kyis/ /sngon gyi sdig pa zad byed cing*/ /bsod nams phung po sdud byed phyir/ /nyan thos rnams las khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa dang*/ rin chen phreng ba las/ rang gi don la mi blta phyir/ /gzhan don ro gcig dga' ba gang*/ /yon tan 'byung gnas theg chen te/ /zhes so/ /de ltar sems btang na byang chub las ring zhing 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal tshad med do/ /gso thabs ni rten la sogs pa'i drung du gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags bsdam bya'o/ /yang sngar bzhin blangs pas skye ste/ grangs nges pa med do/ /'jug pa sems bskyed gso thabs la'ang*/

nyams pa'i rkyen ni rten gzhi smon pa'i sems shor ba/ 'gal zla rtsa ltung byung ba/ spong rkyen bslab pa phul ba gsum yin no/ /nyams pa'i nyes pa ni/ sngar bsags zin gyi dge ba mngon gyur na smad pas phyi ma la bde ba med cing theg chen dang mi 'phrad pa dang*/ dam bca' nyams pas kun gyis smad pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba dang*/ nyes pa lci bas ngan 'gror yun ring du 'khyam par 'gyur ba'o/ /de'ang*/ slob spring las/ gang dag gcig pu'ang yid kyis nges par rab brtags te/ /yang dag las dang lhan cig 'grogs par byed pa de/ /sa steng dkyil na gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa ste/ /slob ma mchog des bla ma bkur ba nyid du gyur/ /ngo tsha yon tan tshogs bskyed ma gcig ya rabs mo/ /mchog tu g.yo med byams par blta ba'i rjes 'brang ba/ /bden dang gzhung la dga' ba'i gzi brjid ldan pa rnams/ /srog ni bde blag gtong bar byed kyi dam bcas min/ /re zhig skye bo kun gyis dpyas dang sdig pa yi/ /'gro ba kun dang dmyal ba mi bzad phar zhog gi /rang bzhi na rnal ma bor nas mod la sdug bsngal ba/ /mkhas la sa steng de las sdug bsngal gzhan ci yod/ gang zhig thub dbang rnams kyis srol gtod chos kyi lam/ /rgya chen gru dang 'dra ba rnyed nas slar 'dor ba/ /'khor ba rgya mtsho'i klong dkyil gar mkhan 'dra rnams la/ /dga' bas nges par de'i sems bslus par gyur pa snyam/ /zhes so/ /de bas na/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba gzhan yang nyams bla yi/ /sems ni nam yang nyams mi bya/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/ /de'ang thun tshod las nyams te shor na 'gyod sems kyis bshags nas sngar bzhin cho ga lan gsum gyis blangs pas sor chud cing*/ grangs nges pa med do/ /nag po pas ni gso thabasakyi rigs gsum gsungs te/ ji skad du/ dman pa kha cig ni dngos por 'dzin pa'i dbang gis 'gyod cing yid la gcags pas gzhan gyi drung du nyes pa 'chags shing*/

phyis sdom pas rim gyis nyes pa de las ring zhig na ldang ba yang yod do/ /bar ma kha cig ni rig sngags dang gsang sngags kyi lha byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po la sogs pa mnyes par byas te lha'i rjes su gnang ba thob pas ltung ba las ldang ngo*/ /dam pa kha cig ni gang gis ltung bar brjod pa de nyid la byang chub kyi sems su shes pas tshegs med par gnas te/ ji ltar/ 'phags pa chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo las gsungs pa/ 'jam dpal/ byang chub sems dpa' gang gis las med cing rnam par smin pa med par shes pa des las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa 'thob bo zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /'dir de'i rjes su 'brang ba ni legs par sems te/ blo dman pa dag gis yul byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi drung ngam rten khyad par can gyi drung du song ste/ yan lag bdun pa byas la gso ba'am/ che ge mo zhes bya ba'i sems dpa' chen po dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la ltung ba 'di zhes bgyi ba byung ba de sems can thams cad kyi phyir bshags kyi dag par mdzad du gsol zhes lan gsum brjod pa dang*/ pha rol pos/ nyes ltung de dag la nyes ltung du gzigs sam/ phyin chad legs par sdom mam zhes pa'i lan du rang gis/ 'khums lags/ sdom lags so zhes brjod pas nyes pa las thar pa yin par byang chub sems dpa'i sa las gsungs so/ /yang bar ma lha'i bskyed rdzogs la nan tan byed pa dag gis/ rang rang gi yi dam lha'i mdun du/ yan lag bdun pa byas la bshags bsdam byas pas ltung ba las ldang ngo*/ / de'ang rigs sngags spyi'i lha 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po ste/ de'i mdun du 'chags par 'dod na/ nyin mtshan gyis bar ma chod par bshags te/ de'ang gang byung dus nas bzung ste nam gyi cha smad kyi bar la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/

khyad par du 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ nyes ltung gi sdig pa 'chags pa rnams drag la rgyun ring bar byas te/ tho rangs kar song ba na 'di skad brjod de/ skya rengs/ bdag gi 'phrin pa mdzad du gsol/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po la bdag gis nyes ltung bshags na dag par mdzad nas dgongs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ nyi ma 'char ka na nyes ltung dag pa'i ltas/ lus sems sngon bas bde ba dang*/ nyi ma'ang 'jam por 'char ba dang*/ nam mkha' dag pa dang*/ rmi lam dge ba ston par gsungs so/ /gang zag mchog kha cig gis ni skyil mo krung bcas te/ thog mar sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bu'i tshul gyis nyes ltung gang yin pa'i ming nas brjod de/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la bshags pa'i rjes la/ nyes pa de nyid nang dang phyi rol dang de gnyis ka'i bar du ngo bo ngos gzung dbyibs kha dog la sogs pa'i brtag pa byas pas/ gang nas kyang ma byung*/ gang du'ang mi gnas/ gar yang mi 'gro ba nam mkha'i rang bzhin can du shes nas de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pas/ nyes ltung thams cad las rnam par grol ba yin te/ thar pa chen po phyogs bcu rgyas pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos bzhi dang ldan na/ tshul khrims nyams pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i kha na ma tho ba'i las thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ chos rnams 'ong ba med pa'i phyir dang*/ chos rnams mi skye bar shes pa'i phyir dang*/ chos rnams mi 'gag par mthong pa'i phyir dang*/ chos rnams rgyu dang rkyen la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i phyir ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa ste/ bzhi po de dang ldan na tshul khrims nyams pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i kha na ma tho ba 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro zhes pa dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ sems can gcig ste gnyis su med par shes na sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ste/

dper na me long gi steng du lo stong gi rdul chags pa gos kyis phyis pas rdul med pa dang mtshungs so/ /yang 'di lta ste/ dper na khang stong gi mun pa mun nag lo stong lon pa yang mar me gcig gis med par byed pa bzhin du sems la ngo bo nyid med pa yang dag pa'i bden pa shes pas bskal pa grangs med pa'i sdig pa skad cig ma la 'byang bar 'gyur ro zhes pa dang*/ don dam pa la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ lha'i bu padma dkar pos gsol pa/ 'jam dpal/ las kyi sgrib pa ji ltar sbyang bar bya/ smras pa*/ lha'i bu/ las kyi sgrib pa ni las nyid ye nas dngos po med par shes na tshegs med par 'dag par 'gyur te/ dung la sol bas gos pa na ras kyis phyis pa dang mtshungs so zhes so/ /de dag gis shes bya shes pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba bstan zin to/ /dgu pa gang gis bsgrub pa'i gang zag gi rim pa bstan pa ni/ da ni bsgrub bya bsgrub pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba ston te/ gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag dang*/ ji ltar bsgrub par bya ba'i don gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyal sras de yang rnam pa gsum nyid de/ /rang nyid grol nas 'gro ba sgrol 'dod pa/ /rgyal po lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang dang 'gro ba mnyam du thar 'dod pa/ /gru pa lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /'gro ba bsgral nas rang nyid zhi 'dod pa/ /rdzi bo lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' gsum/ /rim bzhin grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ /bdun dang gsum gyis grol ba 'thob pa ni/ / dbang po'i rim pa lags par mdo las gsungs/ /de'ang byasang chub sems dpa' 'dod chen pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste/ rang nyid thog mar sangs rgyas nas phyis 'gro ba sgrol ba ni/ dper na rgyal pos rgyal srid thob nas rgyal 'bangs bde ba la 'god par 'dod pa ste/ 'phags pa byams pa lta bu'i sems bskyed du mdo du ma las bshad do/ /rang dang 'gro ba mnyam du grol bar 'dod pa ni ye shes dam pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste/

mnyen pa dag gru'i 'grub bo dang rang nyid mnyam du chu bo'i pha rol tu phyin par 'dod pa'o/ /thog mar sems can bsgral nas gdod rang nyid grol bar 'dod pa dpe med pa'i sems bskyed ces bya ste/ /ra lug dang ba lang gi rdzi bo dag gis 'phrang la sogs pa dog cing nyam nga ba'i gnas mthong ngam*/ /gzhan du'ang rang gi mdun du de dag bcug nas/ gcig kyang phyi la ma lus par byas te 'gro ba ni 'jam dpal dang shākya thub pa lta bu'i sems bskyed yin no/ /de dag kyang dbang po rtul po rnams kyis grangs med sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ 'bring pos bdun dang*/ rnon pos gsum gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba ste/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ de la 'dod chen po'i sems bskyed pas ni grangs med pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyis 'khor ba las thar ba yin no/ /ye shes dam pa'i sems bskyed pas ni grangs med pa bdun gyis tshar phyin pa yin no/ /dpe med pa'i sems bskyed pas ni grangs med pa gsum gyis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems stobs chung ngu dang*/ 'bring dang*/ chen por gyur pa'i phyir te/ 'di dag dper bya na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ gru'i kha lo pa dang*/ skyong byed lta bu'o zhes pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /

bcu pa ji ltar bsgrub bya rgyal ba'i spyod pa la bslab tshul la gnyis las/ mdor bstan pa ni/ gnyis pa ji ltar bsgrub par bya ba'i don ni/ rgyal sras rnams kyis kun la bslab pa ste/ /gtso bor pha rol phyin pa drug la bslab/ /ces pa ste/ bshes spring las/ sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod brtson gsam gtan dang*/ /de bzhin shes rab gzhal med pha rol phyin/ /'di dag rgyas mdzod srid pa'i rgya mtsho yi/ /pha rol phyin pa rgyal ba'i dbang po mdzod/ ces gsungs pa'i tshul la bslab bo/ /de'ang thun mong gi rang bzhin dang*/ so so'i rang bzhin gnyis las/ thun mong la'ang rang gi ngo bo ni drug ste/ 'khor gsum du mi rtog pas rang gi bdog pa gzhan la gtong sems dge ba sa bon dang bcas pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de'i byed las pha rol gyi dbul ba zhi bar byed do/ / 'khor gsum mi rtog pas srid zhi'i skyon spong ba'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa ni tshul khrims so/ /byed las 'tshe ba las log pa'o/ /'khor gsum mi rtog pas gnod pa dang skyo ngal bzod cing chos nyid la mi skrag pa ni bzod pa'o/ /byed las khro ba med pa'o/ /'khor gsum mi rtog pas dge ba la spro ba ni brtson 'grus so/ /byed las dge ba 'phel ba'o/ /'khor gsum mi rtog pas sems rtse gcig pa ni bsam gtan no/ /byed las nyon mongs pa zhi ba'o/ /'khor gsum mi rtog pas chos kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa ni shes rab bo/ /byed las shes bya rtogs shing 'khor ba las sgrol ba'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa de dag gi yon tan ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ gzhan don du byang chub la dmigs pas rgya che ba dang*/ nges par legs pa dang mngon par mtho ba 'grub pas don che ba dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pas zang zing med pa dang*/ dge ba gong du 'phel bas mi zad pa ste/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rgya che ba dang zang zing med/ /don che ba dang mi zad pa/

/sbyin pa la sogs thams cad kyi/ /yon tan bzhir ni shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /grangs nges pa la gsum las/ dang po mngon mtho bsgrub pa dang nyon mongs pa spong ba la ltos te drug tu grangs nges pa ni/ de nyid las/ longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pas mngon mtho dang*/ /rtag tu nyon mongs dbang nyid mi 'gro dang*/ /bya ba rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gzhan don byas pas rang don 'grub pa la ltos te drug tu grangs nges pa ni/ de nyid las/ mi phongs pa dang rnam par mi 'tshe dang*/ / rnam 'tshe bzod dang bya bas mi skyo dang*/ dga' byed legs par brjod pa de yi phyir/ /gzhan gyi don ni rang gi don yin no/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa bslab pa gsum la ltos te phar phyin drug tu grangs nges pa ni/ de nyid las/ bslab gsum dbang du mdzad nas ni/ rgyal bas pha rol phyin pa drug /yang dag bshad de dang po gsum/ /tha ma gnyis kyis rnam pa gnyis/ /gcig ni gsum char la yang gtogs/ /zhes so/ /de'ang dang po gsum lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas bsdus so/ /sbyin pa ni rgyu/ tshul khrims ni ngo bo/ bzod pa ni khyad par yin no/ /tha ma gnyis kyi bsam gtan sems kyi bslab pas bsdus shing*/ shes rab shes rab kyi bslab pas bsdus la/ brtson 'grus gcig pu ni de thams cad kyi grogs su ldan par bsdus pa yin no/ /go rims nges pa ni/ de nyid las/ snga ma la brten phyi ma skye/ /dman dang mchog tu gnas phyir dang*/ /rags pa dang ni phra ba'i phyir// de dag rim par bstan pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de'ang snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma skye bas rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rim pa dang*/ sbyin pa bas tshul khrims mchog pas bzang ngan gyi rim pa dang*/ snga ma snga ma rags shing bslabs dang rtogs par sla la phyi ma phyi ma dka' bas phra rags kyi rim pa ste gsum la ltos nas nges pa yin

no/ /bsgrub tshul ni/ sbyin pa gtong ba na'ang rnam par smin pa la mi re ba dang*/ yang yang srid pa'i gnas 'dir bde 'gro la smon pa med pa'i tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*/ thams cad la bzod par bya bas bzod pa bsgom pa dang*/ yon tan thams cad sdud pa'i brtson 'grus dang*/ gzugs med pa'i khams bsal ba'i bsam gtan dang*/ thabs dang ma bral ba'i tshul gyis shes rab bsgrub par bya ste/ de nyid las/ re ba med pa'i sbyin pa dang*/ / yang srid mi 'dod tshul khrims dang*/ /thams cad la ni bzod pa dang*/ /yon tan kun sdud brtson 'grus dang*/ /de bzhin bsam gtan gzugs med min/ /shes rab thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /pha rol phyin pa drug po la/ /brtan pa rnams kyis yang dag sbyor/ /zhes so/ /nges tshig ni/ de nyid las/ dbul ba sel bar byed pa dang*/ /bsil ba 'thob dang khro bzod dang*/ /mchog la sbyor dang yid 'dzin dang*/ /don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad de/ /zhes so/ / dbul ba sel bas sbyin pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba bsil zhing skyob pas tshul khrims/ khong khro bzod pas bzod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sar sbyor bas brtson 'grus/ sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin pas bsam gtan/ chos kyi rang bzhin don dam pa'i bden pa shes pas shes rab ces bya'o/ / so so'i rang bzhin rgyas par bshad pa la bdun te/ sbyin pa la gsum las/ yul ngos gzung ba ni/ da ni so so'i rang bzhin bshad pa la drug las/ sbyin pa'i rang bzhin ni/ 'di ltar/ 'gro ba dbul bas nyam thag mthong nas ni/ / rang bzhin spyir bstan pa ni/ de la/ zas gos rta dang shing rta glang po sogs/ /mkho dgu'i yo byad dpag med gtong ba ste/ /bu dang bu mo la sogs gtong ba che/ /mgo dang mig sogs shin tu gtong ba ste/ /zang zing dang ni chos kyi phan pa bsgrub/ / phan yon bshad pa ni/ sbyin pa/ des ni rang gi ser sna'i tshogs 'joms shing*/ / gzhan gyi 'byor pa nye bar skye bar 'gyur/

/de'ang zang zing gi sbyin pas bsod nams dang*/ chos kyi sbyin pas ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs te/ rang gi ser sna med pas yi dgas kyi skye ba rgyun gcod cing*/ dngos su gzhan la phan pa'i 'byor ba skye ba yin no/ /'phags pa 'jig rten 'dzin gyis dris pas lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ de la zang zing gi sbyin pas ni bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs la/ chos kyi sbyin pas ni ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs te/ 'di gnyis ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sgrub par byed pa'o/ /de la zang zing gi sbyin pa gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gtong ba dang*/ gtong ba chen po dang*/ shin tu gtong ba'o/ /de la gtong ba zhes bya ba ni/ zas dang*/ gos dang*/ shing rta dang*/ glang po che gzhan la sbyin pa'o/ /gtong pa chen po zhes bya ba ni/ bu dang*/ bu mo dang*/ khyim thab sbyin pa'o/ /shin tu gtong ba zhes bya ba ni/ bya dka' ba ste/ mgo dang*/ mig dang*/ lag pa dang*/ rkang pa la sogs pa gtong ba'o/ /de la chos kyi sbyin pa gang zhe na/ myu gu dang*/ snag tsha dang*/ glegs bam sbyin pa ni chung ngu'o/ /skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ bla na med pa'i chos ston pa ni chen po'o/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dzin du 'jug cing*/ nam mkha' ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos ston pa ni shin tu chen po'o zhes so/ /de'ang byang chub sems dpa' khyim pas gtso bor zang zing gi sbyin pa gtong la/ rab tu byung bas chos kyi sbyin pa gtong ba yin no/ /de dag kyang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ don rnams gtong bar byed pa dang*/ /rtsa ba sems la brten pa dang*/ /lus dang longs spyod phun tshogs dang*/ /gnyis rjes 'dzin dang rdzogs byed dang*/ /de yang ser sna med ldan dang*/ /chos dang mi 'jigs zang zing gtong*/ /sbyin pa de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces so/ /de la ngo bo ni ser sna med pa/

rgyu ni gtong sems dag pa/ 'bras bu ni lus longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub pa/ byed las ni rang gzhan gnyis rjes su 'dzin cing tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa'o/ /yon tan gyi khyad par ni/ de nyid las/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams slob dang phrad na rang gi srog kyang rtag tu gtong*/ /snying rjes gzhan las lan yang mi re 'dod pa'i 'bras bu don mi gnyer/ /sbyin pa de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la bkod/ /sbyin pa ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /ces so/ / tshul khrims la'ang gsum las/ rang bzhin bshad nas bsngags pa brjod pa ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bshad pa ni/ phyi rol pa la med cing nang pa sangs rgyas pa la yod pas/ lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyis ni rgyud bsdams shing*/ sems kyi dge ba zhi ba rnams sgrub la/ shes rab kyis ni don gnyis phun tshogs 'thob/ bslab bya mdor bstan nas bsrung bar gdams pa ni/ de yang*/ sdom dang chos sdud sems can don byed de/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis tshul khrims gsum rtag bsrung*/ / bsrung rten gang zag gi dbye ba dang rtsa ba byang sems su bshad pa ni/ de'i rten/ khyim pas dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas smon 'jug la/ /rab tu byung bas dge slong dge tshul dang*/ /dge slob ma yi sdom pa gang yin steng*/ /byang chub sems gnyis bsrung ba tshul khrims yin/ /de la 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa zhes pa ni/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun gang rung gi steng du smon 'jug gi sems bskyed gnyis dang ldan pa yin la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa tsam la so sor thar pa rigs bdun gyi rnam dbye med pa yin no/ / de'ang dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis/ dge tshul pha ma gnyis/ dge slong pha ma gnyis/ dge slob ma/ bsnyen gnas pha ma gnyis te dgu yod kyang*/ khyim pa'i phyogs kyi dge bsnyen dang bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa gnyis/

rab tu byung ba'i phyogs kyi dge tshul rab byung bar ma dge slong ste lngar rigs bsdu bas na de'i steng du sems bskyed pa gnyis dang ldan pa la brjod do/ /de'ang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rab tu byung ba'i phyogs dag ni/ /yon tan tshad med rnams dang ldan/ /de ltas sdom brtson khyim pa yi/ /byang sems rnams las mchog tu bshad/ /ces pas rab tu 'byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' bshad la/ mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba dang*/ khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bye ba khrag khrig rab tu mang po rnams dang yang thabs gcig ste zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de'ang dge bsnyen la gnyis las/ sna 'ga' bsrung ba sogs kyi dge bsnyen ni rtsa ba bzhi'am bzhi'i gang rung bsrung zhing 'dod log spang ba yin no/ /tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen ni rtsa ba bzhi chang dang*/ de'i steng du mi tshangs par spyod pa spong ba yin no/ / dge tshul ni/ 'od ldan las/ gang zhig srog gcod gzhan gyi nor 'phrog dang*/ /mi tshangs spyod brdzun bcos pa'i chang la sogs/ /gar sogs phreng sogs mal chen mtho ba dang*/ /phyi dro'i kha zas gser dngul len pa spang*/ /zhes pa'i tshul gyi bslab pa'i gnas bcu 'dzin cing*/ gzhan yang phyogs dang mthun pa'i nyes pa las sems bsrung ba yin no/ /dge slob ma ni tshul khrims de'i steng du skyes pa la mi reg pa la sogs pa bcu gnyis spong byed gnyen po dge ba ste/ bud med nyon mongs pa che bas brtan mi brtan nam thub mi thub brtag pa la lo gnyis la sogs par slob pa'o/ /dge slong la pham pa bzhi/ lhag ma bcu gsum/ spang ltung sum cu la sogs pa'i khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum dang*/ dge slong ma la sum brgya dru cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa ste/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba dang*/ phal chen po dang*/ gnas brtan pa dang mang pos bkur ba so so'i sde pa tha dad pa'i tshul khrims kyis bslab par grags pa rnams so/

/sa sde las/ rab tu byung ba'i bslab par brjod pa de dag gi steng du smon 'jug gi sems bskyed thob la ma nyams par yod pa la ni byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung bar gsungs pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i khrims rnams ni rang gi rgyud nyes spyod las sdom pa'i tshul khrims te lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa zhes bya'o/ /de dag kyang spong sems dge ba sa bon dang bcas pa ste/ spyod 'jug las/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa la/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin par brjod/ /ces so/ /de'ang rang rgyud kyi nyes spyod sdom pas mi dge ba bsdams pa'i cha ni so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ste/ 'khor bar lha mi'i lus 'dzin cing rang don bde ba 'thob pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan la mi 'tshe bar ma zad phan pa bsgrub pa'i cha ni byang chub sems dpa'i sdom par gsungs so/ /sngags kyi sdom pa ni de'i steng du tha mal du 'dzin pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa spong zhing rim gnyis bsgom pa'i snod du rung b.rabyas pa'o/ /de'ang so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i rang dus brtsis na mi dge ba bcu rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba yin pas gnang ba'i skabs med pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' la ni bdun gzhan don du gnang ba dang*/ sngags la mi spong bar thabs kyi char bsten te shing las me ltar ye shes skye ba'i rgyur lam zab pas khyad par du byas pa yin no/ /gang zag gcig gi rgyud la ni/ ngo bo gcig la ldog pa'i cha tha dad du yod do/ /yul 'dom na gong ma bsrung ste 'og ma'i cha der 'du ba'i phyir ro/ 'og ma dang rnam pa 'gal ba ltar snang yang ngo bo ma shor bas 'gal ba cung zad kyang med do/ /dper na sngags kyi kun du spyod pa'i skabs su chang 'thung ba la ni nyan thos pas ltung ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpas phyogs mthun gyi nyes par bshad kyang*/ nyes par mi 'gyur te/ de'i tshe yul bdag nyid dge slong ngam byang chub sems dpa' yin dgos pa la/

de'i tshe lhar bskyed pas gzhi gzhan du gyur/ dngos po myos byed chang yin dgos pa la/ sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bdud rtsir bsgyur zhing longs spyad par gsungs pa dang*/ bsam pa'i 'du shes gzhan du ma gyur pa dgos pa la/ lha dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i 'du shes su gnas gyur pas nyes pa med pa'i steng du lha mchod pas tshogs rdzogs pa dang*/ lta ba dang ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i grogs su gyur pas yon tan yar ldan du yod pa bzhin no/ /tshul de bzhin du bslab pa'i cha shas kun la'ang shes par bya'o/ /mdor na nyes pa bskyed na gang gi lugs la'ang 'gog la/ yon tan rnams dge ba bskyed na bya bar gnang bas bslab pa rnams kyi che 'bring dang gnang bkag shes shing spyir btang ba dang*/ dmigs kyis bsal ba shes pa gal che ste/ rin chen phreng ba las/ spyir btang ba la dmigs kyis bsal/ /bstan bcos dag ni kun la bsngags/ /zhes so/ /mdor na nyes spyod cha dang bcas pa las gzhan don du sems bsrung ba ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims so/ /tshogs gnyis dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug gis bsdus pa'i yon tan ma skyes pa bskyed/ skyes pa spel ba ni dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims te/ sems kyi bslab pas gtso bor bsdus pa yin no/ /thabs la mkhas pas dngos sam brgyud nas sems can la phan pa'i don bsgrub la/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis gzhan dga' bar byed cing gnas skabs su mngon par mtho ba dang mthar thug nges par legs pa'i sa bon dge ba 'debs shing gzhan bde lhur len pa ni sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so/ /tshul khrims 'di gsum gyis lam bslab pa gsum bsgrub cing tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas sangs rgyas pa'i tshe sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyis spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa thob par byed do/ /dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims kyis rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa la sogs pa 'thob bo/

/sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims kyis 'phrin las phun sum tshogs pa gang la gang 'dul du de dang 'tshams pa'i don gnyis lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i rgyu can 'thob pa yin no/ /dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'od srungs/ de la byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims ni rnam pa gsum ste/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ sems can gyi don bsgrub pa'i tshul khrims so/ /de la sdom pa'i tshul khrims kyis ni mi dge ba las sems bsrung ba yin no/ /dge ba'i chos srung ba'i tshul khrims kyis ni dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par bsgrub pa yin no/ /sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims kyis ni gzhan la phan pa lhur len pa yin no zhes so/ /de dag kyang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ yan lag drug zhi bsam pas zin/ /bde 'gror gnas pa sbyin byed dang*/ /rten dang zhi dang 'jigs pa med/ /bsod nams tshogs dang ldan pa dang*/ /brdar brtags chos nyid thob pa ste/ /sdom la gnas pa rnams la yod/ /tshul khrims de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces so/ /de la ngo bo ni yan lag drug ldan te/ tshul khrims la gnas pa/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pas bsdams pa cho ga phun sum tshogs pa spyod yul phun sum tshogs pa/ kha na ma tho ba phra rab tsam la'ang 'jigs pa'i gnas su blta ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi rnams yang dag par blangs te slob pa'o zhes nyan thos kyi sa las bshad do/ /rgyu ni zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa thob par byed do/ /'bras bu ni bde 'gror gnas pa'o/ /byed las ni yon tan thams cad kyi rten byed pa'o/ /yang nyon mongs pa zhi ba dang*/ rang gzhan la 'jigs pa med par yang byed do/ /yon tan ni bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ldan pa'o/ /dbye na yang dag par blangs pa brda las byung ba dang*/ chos nyid kyis thob pa'o/ / dang po ni so sor thar pa'o/ /chos nyid kyis thob pa la bsam gtan dang zag med las skyes pa gnyis te/

bsam gtan dngos gzhi'i sems thob pa dang*/ mthong lam la sogs pa zag pa med pa 'phags pa'i sa thob pa yin te/ mdzod las/ sdom pa so sor thar ces bya/ /de bzhin bsam gtan zag med skyes/ /zhes so/ /'di dag ni nyams pa med pa dang*/ nyan rang dang ma 'dres pa dang*/ nyes ltung gis ma sbags pa dang*/ theg chen yin pas mod mi dma' ba ste/ bzhi ldan ni yon tan gyi rten can du bskyed par bya ba nyid/ bshes spring las/ khyod kyis tshul khrims ma nyams mod mi dma'/ ma 'dres ma sbags pa dag bsten par mdzod/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ / yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i tshul khrims kyi yon tan ni/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams sdom dang brtson pa'i rang bzhin tshul khrims gsum rtag blangs/ /mtho ris mngon par mi 'dod yang dag thob kyang de la chags mi bskyed/ /tshul khrims de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la bkod/ /tshul khrims ye shes kyis yongs zin pas 'jig rten dag na mi zad bzhag /ces so/ /

bzod pa la yang bdun las/ dbye ba spyir bstan pa ni/ de nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ phyi nang gnod pa sna tshogs sdug bsngal la/ /ji mi snyam dang snying rjes chos la sems/ /dmigs med bzod pa gsum yang bsgrub par bya/ /'di ltar pha rol gyis gnod pa'am 'tshe ba la sogs pa byas pa la khro ba mi bskyed pa ni mi mjed pa'i bzod pa'o/ /thar pa dang rang gzhan gyi chos bsgrub pa'i dka' spyad bzod pa ni sdug bsngal dang dulen pa ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa'o/ /snying rjes gzhan gyi don la skyo ngal med pa dang*/ stong pa nyid kyi don zab mo la mi skrag pa ni chos nyid dmigs pa med pa'i bzod pa'o/ /de dag gi don yang*/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ mi mjed ji mi snyam shes dang*/ /snying rjes chos la brten pa'i phyir/ /phan yon lngar ni yang dag bshad/ /de ni gnyis kyi don byed de/ /dka' thub gtso dang kun du ldan/ /de la de ni rnam gsum 'dod/ / bzod pa de 'drar yongs shes nas/ /mkhas pas yang dag sgrub par byed/ /ces so/ / ngo bo ni gzhan la mi khro zhing dka' spyad bzod pa'o/ /rgyu ni snying rje'o/ / 'bras bu ni phan yon lnga ste/ mdo las/ khon mi mang ba yin/ dbyen mi mang ba yin/ bde ba dang yid bde ba mang ba yin/ 'gyod pa med par 'chi ba'i dus byed pa yin/ lus zhig nas kyang bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ba yin zhes so/ /byed las ni rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don dge ba byed de/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms las/ gang zhig pha rol 'khrugs shes nas/ /de la bdag ni nyer zhi ba/ /des ni bdag dang pha rol dang*/ /gnyis po dag gi don byed do/ /zhes so/ /yon tan ni/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams shin tu bya dka' de bzhin mi yi gnod kun bzod/ /mtho ris gnyer dang mi nus pas min 'jigs pas ma yin phan ltas min/ / bzod pa de nyid kyis kyang skye bo thams cad byang chub gsum la bkod/
